class EvidenceLedger: 
155class EvidenceLedger:
156    """Manages the append-only evidence ledger log files."""
157
158    def __init__(self, ledger_file: Optional[str] = None):
159        if ledger_file is None:
160            # Default to logs/control_plane/evidence_ledger.jsonl
161            repo_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
162            ledger_file = str(repo_root / "logs" / "control_plane" / "evidence_ledger.jsonl")
163        self.ledger_file = Path(ledger_file)
164        self.ledger_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
165
166    def append_entry(self, entry: EvidenceEntry) -> None:
167        """Validates against the schema, then appends the sanitized entry to the JSON Lines log.
168
169        Nothing is written when validation or serialization fails.
170        """
171        record = entry.to_dict()
172        line = json.dumps(record) + "\n"
173        violations = schema_violations(json.loads(line))
174        if violations:
175            _LOG.error("evidence entry %s (%s) violates the schema: %s", entry.entry_id, entry.action, violations)
176            raise EvidenceSchemaError(
177                f"evidence entry {entry.entry_id} (action={entry.action!r}) violates "
178                f"{_SCHEMA_PATH.name}: " + "; ".join(violations)
179            )
180        with open(self.ledger_file, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
181            f.write(line)
182
183    def read_entries(self, strict: bool = False) -> Tuple[List[EvidenceEntry], List[LedgerDiagnostic]]:
184        """Reads the ledger and reports every record that is not clean.
185
186        Malformed lines cannot be returned and are listed as diagnostics instead of
187        disappearing. Schema-invalid but parseable (for example historical) records are
188        still returned and flagged. With ``strict`` any diagnostic raises
189        :class:`EvidenceCorruptionError`.
190        """
191        entries: List[EvidenceEntry] = []
192        diagnostics: List[LedgerDiagnostic] = []
193        if not self.ledger_file.exists():
194            return entries, diagnostics
195        with open(self.ledger_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
196            for number, raw in enumerate(f, start=1):
197                text = raw.strip()
198                if not text:
199                    continue
200                try:
201                    record = json.loads(text)
202                    entry = EvidenceEntry.from_dict(record)
203                except Exception as exc:
204                    diagnostics.append(LedgerDiagnostic(number, "malformed", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"))
205                    continue
206                entries.append(entry)
207                violations = schema_violations(record)
208                if violations:
209                    diagnostics.append(LedgerDiagnostic(number, "schema_invalid", "; ".join(violations)))
210        if strict and diagnostics:
211            first = diagnostics[0]
212            raise EvidenceCorruptionError(
213                f"{self.ledger_file}: {len(diagnostics)} unclean record(s); first is line "
214                f"{first.line_number} ({first.kind}): {first.reason}"
215            )
216        return entries, diagnostics
217
218    def list_all_entries(self) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
219        """Reads all parseable entries. Skipped malformed lines are logged, never silent."""
220        if not self.ledger_file.exists():
221            return []
222        entries: List[EvidenceEntry] = []
223        skipped = 0
224        with open(self.ledger_file, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
225            for line in f:
226                line = line.strip()
227                if line:
228                    try:
229                        entries.append(EvidenceEntry.from_dict(json.loads(line)))
230                    except Exception:
231                        skipped += 1
232        if skipped:
233            _LOG.warning("%s: skipped %d malformed evidence line(s); run `howlplane doctor`", self.ledger_file, skipped)
234        return entries
235
236    def get_task_entries(self, task_id: str) -> List[EvidenceEntry]:
237        """Retrieves all evidence entries associated with a specific task_id."""
238        return [e for e in self.list_all_entries() if e.task_id == task_id]

class ProviderPoolManager: 
 446class ProviderPoolManager:
 447    """Single owner for resource readiness, capacity, and final selection."""
 448
 449    def __init__(
 450        self,
 451        registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
 452        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
 453        fallback_provider: Optional[str] = None,
 454        resources: Optional[Dict[str, ProviderResourceSettings]] = None,
 455        policy: Optional[ProviderPolicySettings] = None,
 456        operating_mode: str = "connected",
 457        backend_resolver: Optional[Callable[[str], AgentBackend]] = None,
 458        state_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 459        probe_on_start: bool = True,
 460        read_only: bool = False,
 461        semantic_recommender: Optional[SemanticRecommender] = None,
 462        semantic_settings: Optional[SemanticRecommendationSettings] = None,
 463    ):
 464        self.registry = registry or AgentRegistry()
 465        self.avoid_provider = avoid_provider
 466        self.fallback_provider = fallback_provider
 467        self.policy = policy or ProviderPolicySettings()
 468        self.operating_mode = operating_mode
 469        self._backend_resolver = backend_resolver or AgentBackendRegistry.get_backend
 470        self._legacy_mode = resources is None
 471        configured = resources if resources is not None else {
 472            profile.resource_id: ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)
 473            for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
 474        }
 475        self.resources = self._normalize_resources(configured)
 476        self.read_only = read_only
 477        self.semantic_settings = semantic_settings or SemanticRecommendationSettings()
 478        self._semantic_recommender: SemanticRecommender = (
 479            semantic_recommender or DisabledSemanticRecommender()
 480        )
 481        self._semantic_cache: "OrderedDict[Tuple, SemanticRecommendation]" = OrderedDict()
 482        self._semantic_retry_after = 0.0
 483        self._store = ProviderCapacityStore(state_path) if state_path else None
 484        self._provider_states: Dict[str, ProviderStatus] = (
 485            self._store.load() if self._store else {}
 486        )
 487        self._validate_configuration()
 488        self._initialize_states(probe_on_start=probe_on_start)
 489
 490    @classmethod
 491    def from_settings(
 492        cls,
 493        settings: Any,
 494        *,
 495        registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
 496        state_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
 497        read_only: bool = False,
 498        probe_on_start: bool = True,
 499    ) -> "ProviderPoolManager":
 500        """Builds the production pool with deterministic legacy migration."""
 501        actual_registry = registry or AgentRegistry()
 502        configured = dict(settings.providers)
 503        if not configured:
 504            if settings.operating_mode == "local_only":
 505                configured = {"local_ollama": ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)}
 506            else:
 507                configured = {
 508                    profile.resource_id: ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)
 509                    for profile in actual_registry.list_resources()
 510                }
 511        return cls(
 512            registry=actual_registry,
 513            resources=configured,
 514            policy=settings.provider_policy,
 515            operating_mode=settings.operating_mode,
 516            state_path=state_path,
 517            read_only=read_only,
 518            probe_on_start=probe_on_start,
 519            semantic_recommender=build_semantic_recommender(settings.semantic_recommendation),
 520            semantic_settings=settings.semantic_recommendation,
 521        )
 522
 523    @classmethod
 524    def from_config(
 525        cls,
 526        *,
 527        read_only: bool = False,
 528        probe_on_start: bool = True,
 529    ) -> "ProviderPoolManager":
 530        """Builds a pool from canonical plus operator-local configuration."""
 531        from howlplane.control_plane.config_loader import default_loader
 532
 533        capacity_path = Path.home() / ".config" / "howlplane" / "provider_capacity.json"
 534        return cls.from_settings(
 535            default_loader.settings,
 536            state_path=capacity_path,
 537            read_only=read_only,
 538            probe_on_start=probe_on_start,
 539        )
 540
 541    def _normalize(self, resource_id: str) -> str:
 542        return AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(resource_id)
 543
 544    def _normalize_resources(
 545        self,
 546        resources: Dict[str, ProviderResourceSettings],
 547    ) -> Dict[str, ProviderResourceSettings]:
 548        normalized: Dict[str, ProviderResourceSettings] = {}
 549        for supplied_id, resource_config in resources.items():
 550            resource_id = self._normalize(supplied_id)
 551            if resource_id in normalized:
 552                raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 553                    f"Duplicate resource definition after alias normalization: {resource_id}"
 554                )
 555            normalized[resource_id] = (
 556                resource_config
 557                if isinstance(resource_config, ProviderResourceSettings)
 558                else ProviderResourceSettings.model_validate(resource_config)
 559            )
 560        return normalized
 561
 562    def _validate_configuration(self) -> None:
 563        if self.operating_mode not in ("local_only", "connected"):
 564            raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 565                f"Invalid operating mode: {self.operating_mode}"
 566            )
 567        known = {
 568            profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
 569            for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
 570        }
 571        unknown = sorted(set(self.resources).difference(known))
 572        if unknown:
 573            raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 574                f"Unknown configured resource ID(s): {', '.join(unknown)}"
 575            )
 576        preferences = self.policy.preferred_external + self.policy.preferred_local
 577        unknown_preferences = sorted(
 578            {self._normalize(item) for item in preferences}.difference(known)
 579        )
 580        if unknown_preferences:
 581            raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 582                "Unknown preferred resource ID(s): " + ", ".join(unknown_preferences)
 583            )
 584        for resource_id, resource_config in self.resources.items():
 585            profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
 586            if profile is None:
 587                continue
 588            if (
 589                resource_config.interface_id
 590                and resource_config.interface_id != profile.interface_id
 591            ):
 592                raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 593                    f"Invalid interface reference for resource '{resource_id}'."
 594                )
 595            if resource_config.model_id:
 596                if profile.model_id and resource_config.model_id != profile.model_id:
 597                    if not profile.model_configurable:
 598                        raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 599                            f"Invalid model reference for resource '{resource_id}'."
 600                        )
 601                elif profile.model_id is None and not profile.model_configurable:
 602                    raise ProviderConfigurationError(
 603                        f"Model identity is not configurable for resource '{resource_id}'."
 604                    )
 605
 606    def _new_status(self, profile: AgentProfile) -> ProviderStatus:
 607        identity = profile.resource_identity()
 608        return ProviderStatus(
 609            agent_id=profile.agent_id,
 610            name=profile.name,
 611            provider_id=identity.provider_id,
 612            interface_id=identity.interface_id,
 613            resource_id=identity.resource_id,
 614            model_id=identity.model_id,
 615        )
 616
 617    def _resource_identity(self, profile: AgentProfile) -> ResourceIdentity:
 618        """Returns configured/observed identity without mutating the profile."""
 619        base = profile.resource_identity()
 620        state = self._provider_states.get(base.resource_id)
 621        return ResourceIdentity(
 622            provider_id=base.provider_id,
 623            interface_id=base.interface_id,
 624            resource_id=base.resource_id,
 625            model_id=state.model_id if state is not None else base.model_id,
 626        )
 627
 628    def _initialize_states(self, *, probe_on_start: bool) -> None:
 629        known_ids: Set[str] = set()
 630        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
 631            resource_id = profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
 632            known_ids.add(resource_id)
 633            state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id) or self._new_status(profile)
 634            self._provider_states[resource_id] = state
 635            resource_config = self.resources.get(resource_id)
 636            if resource_config is None:
 637                self._disable_without_probe(state, "NOT_CONFIGURED")
 638                continue
 639            if not resource_config.enabled:
 640                self._disable_without_probe(state, "OPERATOR_DISABLED")
 641                continue
 642            if self._egress_forbidden(profile):
 643                self._disable_without_probe(state, "EGRESS_FORBIDDEN")
 644                continue
 645            if resource_config.model_id:
 646                state.model_id = resource_config.model_id
 647            if probe_on_start:
 648                self._apply_readiness(resource_id, profile, state)
 649        self._provider_states = {
 650            key: value for key, value in self._provider_states.items() if key in known_ids
 651        }
 652        self._persist()
 653
 654    def _disable_without_probe(self, state: ProviderStatus, reason: str) -> None:
 655        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DISABLED
 656        state.readiness = ReadinessStatus.NOT_PROBED
 657        state.unavailable_reason = reason
 658        state.observed_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 659
 660    def _egress_forbidden(self, profile: AgentProfile) -> bool:
 661        return (
 662            self.operating_mode == "local_only"
 663            and profile.locality != ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value
 664        )
 665
 666    def _apply_readiness(
 667        self,
 668        resource_id: str,
 669        profile: AgentProfile,
 670        state: ProviderStatus,
 671    ) -> BackendReadiness:
 672        backend = self._backend_resolver(resource_id)
 673        readiness = backend.probe_readiness()
 674        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 675        state.readiness = ReadinessStatus(readiness.status)
 676        state.authentication = AuthenticationStatus(readiness.authentication)
 677        state.unavailable_reason = readiness.reason
 678        state.evidence = readiness.evidence
 679        state.unattended_mutation_capable = readiness.unattended_mutation_capable
 680        state.capability_reason = readiness.capability_reason
 681        state.last_checked = now
 682        state.observed_at = now
 683        failure_states = {
 684            ReadinessStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
 685            ReadinessStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
 686            ReadinessStatus.UNREACHABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
 687            ReadinessStatus.UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
 688        }
 689        if readiness.status in failure_states:
 690            state.status = failure_states[readiness.status]
 691        elif readiness.status == ReadinessStatus.READY:
 692            retained = {
 693                ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
 694                ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
 695                ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
 696            }
 697            if state.status not in retained:
 698                if self._legacy_mode or profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
 699                    state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
 700                else:
 701                    state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
 702        return readiness
 703
 704    def _persist(self) -> None:
 705        if self._store and not self.read_only:
 706            self._store.save(self._provider_states)
 707
 708    def get_status(self, agent_id: str) -> ProviderAvailabilityStatus:
 709        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
 710        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
 711        return state.status if state else ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
 712
 713    def get_resource_status(self, resource_id: str) -> Optional[ProviderStatus]:
 714        return self._provider_states.get(self._normalize(resource_id))
 715
 716    def set_status(
 717        self,
 718        agent_id: str,
 719        status: ProviderAvailabilityStatus,
 720        event: Optional[ProviderExhaustionEvent] = None,
 721    ) -> None:
 722        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
 723        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
 724        if state is None:
 725            profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
 726            state = self._new_status(profile) if profile else ProviderStatus(
 727                agent_id=resource_id,
 728                name=resource_id,
 729                resource_id=resource_id,
 730            )
 731            self._provider_states[resource_id] = state
 732        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus(status)
 733        if state.status == ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE:
 734            state.readiness = ReadinessStatus.READY
 735            state.unavailable_reason = None
 736        state.last_checked = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 737        state.observed_at = state.last_checked
 738        if event:
 739            state.exhaustion_event = event
 740        self._persist()
 741
 742    def get_all_statuses(self) -> Dict[str, str]:
 743        return {
 744            resource_id: state.status.value
 745            for resource_id, state in sorted(self._provider_states.items())
 746        }
 747
 748    def inventory(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
 749        """Returns registered, configured, readiness, and capacity distinctions."""
 750        rows = []
 751        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
 752            resource_id = profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
 753            resource_config = self.resources.get(resource_id)
 754            state = self._provider_states[resource_id]
 755            rows.append({
 756                "identity": self._resource_identity(profile).to_dict(),
 757                "name": profile.name,
 758                "registered": True,
 759                "configured": resource_config is not None,
 760                "enabled": bool(resource_config and resource_config.enabled),
 761                "locality": profile.locality,
 762                "economic_class": profile.economic_class,
 763                "readiness": state.readiness.value,
 764                "authentication": state.authentication.value,
 765                "unattended_mutation_capable": state.unattended_mutation_capable,
 766                "capability_reason": state.capability_reason,
 767                "capacity": state.status.value,
 768                "reason": state.unavailable_reason,
 769                "observed_at": state.observed_at,
 770                "last_success_at": state.last_success_at,
 771                "last_failure_at": state.last_failure_at,
 772                "metered_invocation_count": state.metered_invocation_count,
 773                "retry_after": state.retry_after,
 774                "reset_at": state.reset_at,
 775            })
 776        return rows
 777
 778    def has_available_providers(self) -> bool:
 779        usable = {
 780            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE,
 781            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
 782            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN,
 783        }
 784        return any(state.status in usable for state in self._provider_states.values())
 785
 786    def is_all_cloud_exhausted(self) -> bool:
 787        cloud = []
 788        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
 789            if profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
 790                continue
 791            state = self._provider_states.get(profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id)
 792            if state and state.status != ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DISABLED:
 793                cloud.append(state.status)
 794        unavailable = {
 795            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
 796            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
 797            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
 798            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
 799            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
 800            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
 801            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
 802        }
 803        return not cloud or all(status in unavailable for status in cloud)
 804
 805    def is_all_exhausted(self) -> bool:
 806        active = [
 807            state.status
 808            for state in self._provider_states.values()
 809            if state.status != ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DISABLED
 810        ]
 811        exhausted = {
 812            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
 813            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
 814            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
 815        }
 816        return bool(active) and all(status in exhausted for status in active)
 817
 818    def classify_failure(
 819        self,
 820        agent_id: str,
 821        result: AgentExecutionResult,
 822    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
 823        """Retains the pool's instance classification contract."""
 824        return ProviderPoolManager.classify_result(self._normalize(agent_id), result)
 825
 826    @staticmethod
 827    def classify_result(
 828        agent_id: str,
 829        result: AgentExecutionResult,
 830    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
 831        """Normalizes availability separately from engineering results."""
 832        if result.success:
 833            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
 834        resource_id = AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(agent_id)
 835        combined = "\n".join(
 836            [result.error_message or "", result.stderr or "", result.stdout or ""]
 837        ).lower()
 838        # Structural execution evidence outranks transcript text. A long agent
 839        # transcript is arbitrary third-party content that routinely contains the
 840        # very phrases these markers look for, so where the harness observed the
 841        # process directly, that observation wins (SLOPFIX-03).
 842        metadata = result.metadata or {}
 843        if metadata.get(WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_KEY) == WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_STALL:
 844            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED
 845        launch_outcome = metadata.get(LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY)
 846        if launch_outcome in (LAUNCH_OUTCOME_NOT_INSTALLED, LAUNCH_OUTCOME_SPAWN_FAILED):
 847            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
 848        # A harness-sourced or budget-derived timeout is this process stopping
 849        # the provider at our own budget (either directly via harness kill or
 850        # via a harness-derived print timeout). Nothing was observed about
 851        # reachability, so it is an execution budget result, not a transport
 852        # failure. Transcript-sourced timeouts without budget derivation still
 853        # fall through to the transport branch below, where a provider genuinely
 854        # reporting that it could not reach its service is classified as
 855        # TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE and benched (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
 856        # A vendor trust refusal opens the output before any work happens. It
 857        # outranks a deadline only when positively identified for this CLI: a
 858        # session that sat on its own trust prompt until our budget expired was
 859        # blocked by the folder, not slow (see workspace_trust).
 860        if result_is_trust_refusal(resource_id, result):
 861            return ProviderFailureClass.WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED
 862        if (
 863            metadata.get(TIMEOUT_SOURCE_KEY) in (TIMEOUT_SOURCE_HARNESS, TIMEOUT_SOURCE_BUDGET)
 864            or metadata.get(BUDGET_DERIVED_KEY) is True
 865        ):
 866            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
 867        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and result.exit_code == 127:
 868            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
 869
 870        # A provider's exact terminal error is stronger than evidence collected
 871        # earlier in its session. In particular, a hard capacity stop must not
 872        # be hidden by an earlier denied tool. However, arbitrary trailing prose
 873        # in stdout must NEVER override a structured denial: only authenticated
 874        # structured metadata or explicit non-zero exit stderr can outrank it.
 875        if metadata.get(TOOL_PERMISSION_KEY) == TOOL_PERMISSION_DENIED:
 876            structured_terminal = _classify_structured_terminal_hard_failure(result)
 877            if structured_terminal is not None:
 878                return structured_terminal
 879            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
 880
 881        # A machine-readable error envelope is the strongest signal a provider
 882        # can give about why it stopped, and it does not depend on where the
 883        # message happens to sit in the output. Devin's quota error is a
 884        # multi-line JSON blob whose last non-empty line is "}", so the
 885        # anchored line matching below cannot see it at all, whatever patterns
 886        # are added (issues.md #15).
 887        envelope_failure = _classify_structured_error_envelope(result)
 888        if envelope_failure is not None:
 889            return envelope_failure
 890
 891        terminal_hard_failure = _classify_terminal_hard_failure(result)
 892        if terminal_hard_failure is not None:
 893            return terminal_hard_failure
 894
 895        # A provider that demonstrably started cannot be a missing executable,
 896        # whatever its session log says about commands that were not found.
 897        # Backends that stamp no markers keep the older text-based behavior, with
 898        # one correction: a timeout verdict is the more specific signal and so
 899        # outranks the substring scan. Exit 127 remains a legacy launch verdict
 900        # only when no structural launched marker contradicts it.
 901        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and (
 902            not result.timed_out and any(marker in combined for marker in (
 903                "command not found", "binary not found", "not installed",
 904            ))
 905        ):
 906            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
 907        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 908            "requires approval", "require approval", "permission denied",
 909            "requires permission", "execution permission required", "execution_permission_required",
 910            "needs approval", "approve bash execution",
 911            # Trust prose that is not a positively identified refusal (above)
 912            # keeps its conservative, pre-existing permission classification.
 913            "workspace trust required", "trust the current workspace", "pass --trust",
 914            "untrusted workspace",
 915        )):
 916            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
 917        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 918            "authentication required", "not authenticated", "login required",
 919            "unauthorized", "invalid api key",
 920        )):
 921            return ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
 922        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 923            "429 too many requests", "rate_limit", "rate limit", "rate limited",
 924        )):
 925            return ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED
 926        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 927            "quota exhausted", "quota exceeded", "insufficient_quota",
 928            "credits exhausted", "insufficient funds", "resource exhausted",
 929        )):
 930            return ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
 931        session_patterns = EXHAUSTION_PATTERNS.get(resource_id, []) + [
 932            "usage limit",
 933            "session limit",
 934            "individual quota reached",
 935            "quota reached",
 936            "upgrade your subscription",
 937            "out of capacity",
 938        ]
 939        if any(marker in combined for marker in session_patterns):
 940            return ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT
 941        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 942            "malformed", "invalid json", "invalid yaml", "parse error",
 943        )):
 944            return ProviderFailureClass.MALFORMED_OUTPUT
 945        if result.timed_out or any(marker in combined for marker in (
 946            "connection refused", "transport unavailable", "network unreachable",
 947            "timed out", "timeout waiting for response", "request timed out",
 948            "connection timed out", "gateway timeout", "read timeout",
 949            "operation timed out", "deadline exceeded", "timeout after",
 950        )):
 951            return ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE
 952        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
 953            "provider unavailable", "service unavailable", "overloaded_error", "outage",
 954        )):
 955            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
 956        return ProviderFailureClass.ENGINEERING_FAILURE
 957
 958    def record_result(
 959        self,
 960        agent_id: str,
 961        result: AgentExecutionResult,
 962        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
 963        role: Optional[str] = None,
 964    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
 965        """Updates shared state only when the observed result warrants it."""
 966        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
 967        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
 968        if state is None:
 969            raise KeyError(f"Unknown resource '{resource_id}'.")
 970        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 971        profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
 972        if (
 973            profile is not None
 974            and profile.economic_class == EconomicClass.METERED_API.value
 975        ):
 976            state.metered_invocation_count += 1
 977            self._persist()
 978        if result.success:
 979            state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
 980            state.normalized_failure_class = None
 981            state.unavailable_reason = None
 982            state.exhaustion_event = None
 983            state.success_count += 1
 984            state.total_duration_seconds += result.duration_seconds
 985            state.last_success_at = now.isoformat()
 986            state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
 987            state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
 988            state.retry_after = None
 989            if role and role in state.role_exclusions:
 990                state.role_exclusions.pop(role, None)
 991            self._persist()
 992            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
 993
 994        failure_class = self.classify_failure(resource_id, result)
 995        metadata = result.metadata or {}
 996        if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED:
 997            # One untrusted folder says nothing about the resource anywhere
 998            # else: availability, cooldowns, and role eligibility are unchanged.
 999            state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
1000            state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
1001            self._persist()
1002            return failure_class
1003
1004        state.consecutive_failures += 1
1005        state.last_failure_at = now.isoformat()
1006        state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
1007        state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
1008        state.normalized_failure_class = failure_class.value
1009        state.unavailable_reason = failure_class.value
1010
1011        if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED:
1012            target_role = role or "unknown"
1013            state.role_exclusions[target_role] = failure_class.value
1014            if self._is_review_role(target_role):
1015                state.role_exclusions["review"] = failure_class.value
1016            self._persist()
1017            return failure_class
1018
1019        # EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED previously stayed out of this map to avoid
1020        # penalizing a healthy resource for our own harness deadline. The live
1021        # incident showed repeatedly burning ~10-minute slots on the same provider
1022        # while another was available, so a bounded DEGRADED cooldown is recorded
1023        # instead. DEGRADED still leaves the provider eligible, just deprioritized,
1024        # and expires after the normal transient cooldown.
1025        availability_map = {
1026            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
1027            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1028            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
1029            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
1030            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1031            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1032            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1033            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1034            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1035        }
1036        if failure_class in availability_map:
1037            state.status = availability_map[failure_class]
1038            # Every capacity condition expires. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED was absent from
1039            # this set, so a quota event had no `retry_after` at all and the
1040            # resource stayed unavailable until someone called reset_resource --
1041            # a single historical quota event permanently removing a provider
1042            # from the pool. It now expires on its own, longer clock: a quota is
1043            # billed over a day or a week, so re-probing it on the transient
1044            # cooldown would spend attempts proving what is already known
1045            # (issues.md #15).
1046            transient = {
1047                ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1048                ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1049                ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1050                ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
1051            }
1052            cooldown = None
1053            if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT:
1054                cooldown = getattr(
1055                    self.policy, "session_cooldown_seconds", None
1056                ) or 14400
1057            elif failure_class in transient:
1058                cooldown = self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1059            elif failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED:
1060                cooldown = getattr(
1061                    self.policy, "quota_cooldown_seconds", None
1062                ) or self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1063            explicit_retry_seconds = metadata.get(PROVIDER_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS_KEY)
1064            if isinstance(explicit_retry_seconds, int) and explicit_retry_seconds >= 0:
1065                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=explicit_retry_seconds)).isoformat()
1066            elif cooldown:
1067                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=cooldown)).isoformat()
1068            state.exhaustion_event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1069                agent_id=resource_id,
1070                failure_type={
1071                    ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: "session_limit",
1072                    ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: "rate_limit",
1073                    ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: "quota_exhausted",
1074                    ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: "authentication_required",
1075                    ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: "stalled",
1076                }.get(failure_class, "unavailable"),
1077                raw_error=(result.stderr or result.error_message or failure_class.value).strip(),
1078                task_id=task_id,
1079            )
1080            self._persist()
1081        return failure_class
1082
1083    def detect_exhaustion(
1084        self,
1085        agent_id: str,
1086        result: AgentExecutionResult,
1087        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
1088        role: Optional[str] = None,
1089    ) -> Optional[ProviderExhaustionEvent]:
1090        """Compatibility wrapper returning events only for availability failures."""
1091        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
1092        if resource_id in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS:
1093            reason = (result.error_message or "").upper()
1094            if reason == "RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED":
1095                event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1096                    agent_id=resource_id,
1097                    failure_type="unavailable",
1098                    raw_error=result.stderr or reason,
1099                    task_id=task_id,
1100                )
1101                self.set_status(
1102                    resource_id,
1103                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED,
1104                    event,
1105                )
1106                return event
1107        failure_class = self.record_result(agent_id, result, task_id=task_id, role=role)
1108        availability_classes = {
1109            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1110            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
1111            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1112            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
1113            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1114            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1115            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1116        }
1117        if failure_class not in availability_classes:
1118            return None
1119        return self._provider_states[self._normalize(agent_id)].exhaustion_event
1120
1121    def reset_resource(self, resource_id: str, *, reprobe: bool = True) -> ProviderStatus:
1122        """Clears only current availability state for one configured resource."""
1123        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1124        profile = self.registry.get_resource(normalized)
1125        config = self.resources.get(normalized)
1126        if profile is None or config is None:
1127            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is not configured.")
1128        if not config.enabled:
1129            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is operator disabled.")
1130        state = self._provider_states[normalized]
1131        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
1132        state.normalized_failure_class = None
1133        state.exhaustion_event = None
1134        state.retry_after = None
1135        state.reset_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1136        state.unavailable_reason = None
1137        state.role_exclusions.clear()
1138        if reprobe and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1139            self._apply_readiness(normalized, profile, state)
1140        self._persist()
1141        return state
1142
1143    def reset_transient_exhaustion(self) -> None:
1144        """Compatibility reset using bounded non-generative readiness probes."""
1145        for resource_id, resource_config in self.resources.items():
1146            if resource_config.enabled:
1147                profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
1148                if profile and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1149                    self.reset_resource(resource_id, reprobe=True)
1150
1151    def _task_forbids_egress(self, task: TaskSpec) -> bool:
1152        if task.metadata.get("allow_egress") is False:
1153            return True
1154        combined = " ".join(task.constraints).lower()
1155        return "no egress" in combined or "zero external" in combined
1156
1157    def _required_capabilities(self, task: TaskSpec, role: str) -> List[str]:
1158        required = set(task.metadata.get("required_resource_capabilities", []))
1159        if role in ("implementation", "remediation"):
1160            required.update({"file_editing", "repository_access"})
1161        elif self._is_review_role(role):
1162            required.add("code_review")
1163        else:
1164            required.add("code_generation")
1165        if "terminal_execution" in task.allowed_tools:
1166            required.add("command_execution")
1167        return sorted(required)
1168
1169    @staticmethod
1170    def _is_review_role(role: str) -> bool:
1171        return (
1172            role == "review"
1173            or role.endswith("-reviewer")
1174            or role == "test-falsifier"
1175        )
1176
1177    @staticmethod
1178    def _has_capability(profile: AgentProfile, capability: str) -> bool:
1179        facts = {
1180            "repository_access": profile.supports_repository_access,
1181            "command_execution": profile.supports_command_execution,
1182            "structured_output": profile.supports_structured_output,
1183            "tool_calling": profile.supports_tool_calling,
1184        }
1185        return facts.get(capability, capability in profile.capabilities)
1186
1187    @staticmethod
1188    def _capacity_exclusion(status: ProviderAvailabilityStatus) -> Optional[str]:
1189        blocked = {
1190            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
1191            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
1192            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1193            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1194            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1195            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1196            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1197            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED,
1198        }
1199        return status.value if status in blocked else None
1200
1201    def check_capacity_exclusion(
1202        self,
1203        resource_id: str,
1204        role: Optional[str] = None,
1205    ) -> Optional[str]:
1206        """Returns the capacity block or role exclusion reason for a resource, if any."""
1207        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1208        state = self._provider_states.get(normalized)
1209        if state is None:
1210            return "UNKNOWN_RESOURCE"
1211        general = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1212        if general:
1213            return general
1214        if role:
1215            if role in state.role_exclusions:
1216                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}"
1217            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1218                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}"
1219        return None
1220
1221    def _recover_capacity_if_due(
1222        self,
1223        resource_id: str,
1224        profile: AgentProfile,
1225        state: ProviderStatus,
1226    ) -> None:
1227        """Performs at most one safe re-probe after an observed cooldown."""
1228        if not state.retry_after:
1229            return
1230        try:
1231            due = datetime.fromisoformat(state.retry_after)
1232        except ValueError:
1233            return
1234        if datetime.now(timezone.utc) < due:
1235            return
1236        state.retry_after = None
1237        state.exhaustion_event = None
1238        state.normalized_failure_class = None
1239        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
1240        if self.read_only:
1241            state.readiness = ReadinessStatus.NOT_PROBED
1242            return
1243        self._apply_readiness(resource_id, profile, state)
1244        self._persist()
1245
1246    def _recommend(
1247        self,
1248        task: TaskSpec,
1249        role: str,
1250        candidates: List[AgentProfile],
1251    ) -> CognitiveRecommendation:
1252        from howlplane.control_plane.router import TaskRouter
1253
1254        preferences = [
1255            self._normalize(item)
1256            for item in self.policy.preferred_external + self.policy.preferred_local
1257        ]
1258        return TaskRouter(self.registry).recommend_resource(
1259            task,
1260            candidates,
1261            role=role,
1262            operator_preferences=preferences,
1263        )
1264
1265    def configure_semantic(
1266        self,
1267        settings: SemanticRecommendationSettings,
1268        recommender: Optional[SemanticRecommender] = None,
1269    ) -> None:
1270        """Replaces semantic policy, for example from a CLI override."""
1271        self.semantic_settings = settings
1272        self._semantic_recommender = recommender or build_semantic_recommender(settings)
1273        self._semantic_cache.clear()
1274        self._semantic_retry_after = 0.0
1275
1276    def _semantic_assess(
1277        self,
1278        task: TaskSpec,
1279        role: str,
1280        candidates: List[AgentProfile],
1281        *,
1282        explicit_override: bool,
1283        task_forbids_egress: bool,
1284        deterministic: CognitiveRecommendation,
1285    ) -> Optional[SemanticRecommendation]:
1286        """Asks System 1 about already-eligible candidates and applies Plane policy.
1287
1288        Returns None when the feature is off so that evidence for existing
1289        installations is unchanged. The candidates are exactly the survivors of
1290        hard filtering; this method cannot add or remove one.
1291        """
1292        settings = self.semantic_settings
1293        mode = settings.mode
1294        if mode == SemanticMode.OFF.value:
1295            return None
1296        ids = candidate_ids(candidates)
1297
1298        def skipped(reason: str) -> SemanticRecommendation:
1299            return SemanticRecommendation(
1300                status=SemanticStatus.NOT_APPLICABLE,
1301                mode=mode,
1302                reason=reason,
1303                candidate_ids=ids,
1304                deterministic_recommendation=deterministic.resource_id,
1305            )
1306
1307        if role not in settings.decision_roles:
1308            return skipped("role is not a configured semantic decision role")
1309        if explicit_override:
1310            return skipped("an explicit resource override is authoritative")
1311        if len(ids) < 2:
1312            return skipped("fewer than two eligible candidates")
1313        if task_forbids_egress:
1314            return skipped("task forbids egress")
1315        if self.operating_mode == "local_only" and not settings.allow_in_local_only:
1316            return skipped("operating mode is local_only")
1317
1318        digest = hashlib.sha256(
1319            f"{task.objective}|{task.task_class}|{task.risk_level}".encode("utf-8")
1320        ).hexdigest()
1321        key = (task.task_id, role, mode, tuple(ids), digest)
1322        cached = self._semantic_cache.get(key)
1323        if cached is not None:
1324            self._semantic_cache.move_to_end(key)
1325            return cached
1326        if time.monotonic() < self._semantic_retry_after:
1327            return SemanticRecommendation(
1328                status=SemanticStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1329                mode=mode,
1330                reason="recent failure; HowlInstinct not retried yet",
1331                candidate_ids=ids,
1332                deterministic_recommendation=deterministic.resource_id,
1333            )
1334
1335        raw = self._semantic_recommender.recommend(
1336            task=task,
1337            candidates=sorted(candidates, key=lambda p: p.resource_id or p.agent_id),
1338            role=role,
1339            context=RecommendationContext(
1340                capacity=self.get_all_statuses(),
1341                timeout_seconds=settings.timeout_seconds,
1342            ),
1343        )
1344        # Defence in depth: a judge may never name a resource Plane did not offer.
1345        if raw.selected_resource_id is not None and raw.selected_resource_id not in ids:
1346            raw = SemanticRecommendation(
1347                status=SemanticStatus.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE,
1348                mode=mode,
1349                attempted=True,
1350                reason="the judgment named a resource Plane did not offer",
1351                candidate_ids=ids,
1352            )
1353        result = apply_policy(
1354            replace(raw, mode=mode, candidate_ids=ids),
1355            minimum_instinct_margin=settings.minimum_instinct_margin,
1356        )
1357        result = replace(
1358            result,
1359            deterministic_recommendation=deterministic.resource_id,
1360            applied=(
1361                mode == SemanticMode.ACTIVE.value
1362                and result.status is SemanticStatus.ACCEPTED
1363            ),
1364        )
1365        if result.status in (SemanticStatus.ACCEPTED, SemanticStatus.LOW_CONFIDENCE):
1366            self._semantic_cache[key] = result
1367            while len(self._semantic_cache) > 256:
1368                self._semantic_cache.popitem(last=False)
1369        elif result.status in (SemanticStatus.UNAVAILABLE, SemanticStatus.TIMEOUT):
1370            self._semantic_retry_after = time.monotonic() + 30.0
1371        return result
1372
1373    def _ranking_key(
1374        self,
1375        profile: AgentProfile,
1376        recommendation: CognitiveRecommendation,
1377        avoid_resource_id: Optional[str],
1378    ) -> Tuple[int, int, int, int, str]:
1379        economic = EconomicClass(profile.economic_class or EconomicClass.UNKNOWN)
1380        if self.policy.subscription_first:
1381            economic_rank = {
1382                EconomicClass.SUBSCRIPTION: 0,
1383                EconomicClass.LOCAL: 1,
1384                EconomicClass.UNKNOWN: 2,
1385                EconomicClass.METERED_API: 3,
1386            }[economic]
1387        elif self.policy.external_before_local:
1388            economic_rank = 1 if economic == EconomicClass.LOCAL else 0
1389        else:
1390            economic_rank = 0
1391        state = self._provider_states[profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id]
1392        capacity_rank = {
1393            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE: 0,
1394            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED: 1,
1395            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN: 2,
1396        }.get(state.status, 3)
1397        cognitive_rank = 0 if profile.resource_id == recommendation.resource_id else 1
1398        avoid_rank = 1 if profile.resource_id == avoid_resource_id else 0
1399        return (
1400            economic_rank,
1401            capacity_rank if self.policy.prefer_existing_capacity else 0,
1402            cognitive_rank,
1403            avoid_rank,
1404            profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
1405        )
1406
1407    def select_resource(
1408        self,
1409        task: TaskSpec,
1410        *,
1411        role: str,
1412        explicit_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1413        avoid_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1414        exclude_resource_ids: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
1415    ) -> ResourceSelectionDecision:
1416        """Applies hard filtering, economics, recommendation, and stable tie break.
1417
1418        ``avoid_resource_id`` is a soft preference that only demotes a resource in
1419        the ranking. ``exclude_resource_ids`` is a hard prohibition, used by
1420        bounded failover so a resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt cannot
1421        be re-offered and dead-end the loop.
1422        """
1423        required = self._required_capabilities(task, role)
1424        excluded_ids = {
1425            self._normalize(item) for item in (exclude_resource_ids or []) if item
1426        }
1427        registered = [
1428            self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1429        ]
1430        exclusions: List[ResourceExclusion] = []
1431        candidates: List[AgentProfile] = []
1432        task_forbids_egress = self._task_forbids_egress(task)
1433
1434        def exclude(profile: AgentProfile, reason: str, stage: str, detail=None):
1435            exclusions.append(ResourceExclusion(
1436                resource_id=profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
1437                reason=reason,
1438                stage=stage,
1439                detail=detail,
1440            ))
1441
1442        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
1443            resource_id = profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1444            resource_config = self.resources.get(resource_id)
1445            state = self._provider_states[resource_id]
1446            if resource_config is None:
1447                exclude(profile, "NOT_CONFIGURED", "operator_permission")
1448                continue
1449            if not resource_config.enabled:
1450                exclude(profile, "OPERATOR_DISABLED", "operator_permission")
1451                continue
1452            if self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1453                exclude(profile, "EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1454                continue
1455            if task_forbids_egress and profile.locality != ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1456                exclude(profile, "TASK_EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1457                continue
1458            self._recover_capacity_if_due(resource_id, profile, state)
1459            if state.readiness in {
1460                ReadinessStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1461                ReadinessStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1462                ReadinessStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1463                ReadinessStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1464            }:
1465                exclude(profile, state.readiness.value, "runtime_readiness")
1466                continue
1467            if role not in profile.roles and not (
1468                self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in profile.roles
1469            ):
1470                exclude(profile, "ROLE_NOT_SUPPORTED", "capability")
1471                continue
1472            missing = [cap for cap in required if not self._has_capability(profile, cap)]
1473            if missing:
1474                exclude(
1475                    profile,
1476                    "MISSING_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY",
1477                    "capability",
1478                    ",".join(missing),
1479                )
1480                continue
1481            if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES and profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1482                exclude(profile, "LOCAL_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN", "authority")
1483                continue
1484            capacity_reason = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1485            if capacity_reason:
1486                exclude(profile, capacity_reason, "capacity")
1487                continue
1488            if role in state.role_exclusions:
1489                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}", "capacity")
1490                continue
1491            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1492                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}", "capacity")
1493                continue
1494            if resource_id in excluded_ids:
1495                exclude(profile, "ALREADY_ATTEMPTED", "failover_policy")
1496                continue
1497            trust_block = self._workspace_trust_block(resource_id, task)
1498            if trust_block:
1499                # Scoped to this task's workspace: the resource stays eligible elsewhere.
1500                exclude(profile, "WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED", "workspace_trust", trust_block)
1501                continue
1502            economics = EconomicClass(profile.economic_class or EconomicClass.UNKNOWN)
1503            if economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API and not self.policy.allow_paid_api:
1504                exclude(profile, "PAID_API_FORBIDDEN", "economic_policy")
1505                continue
1506            if (
1507                economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API
1508                and self.policy.max_metered_invocations is not None
1509                and state.metered_invocation_count
1510                >= self.policy.max_metered_invocations
1511            ):
1512                exclude(profile, "METERED_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED", "economic_policy")
1513                continue
1514            candidates.append(profile)
1515
1516        recommendation = self._recommend(task, role, candidates)
1517        supplied_explicit = explicit_resource_id or task.preferred_agent
1518        explicit_id = self._normalize(supplied_explicit) if supplied_explicit else None
1519        semantic = self._semantic_assess(
1520            task,
1521            role,
1522            candidates,
1523            explicit_override=explicit_id is not None,
1524            task_forbids_egress=task_forbids_egress,
1525            deterministic=recommendation,
1526        )
1527        rank_recommendation = recommendation
1528        semantic_blocked = False
1529        if semantic is not None:
1530            if semantic.applied and semantic.selected_resource_id:
1531                rank_recommendation = CognitiveRecommendation(
1532                    resource_id=semantic.selected_resource_id,
1533                    reason=f"HowlInstinct judgment accepted by Plane policy: {semantic.reason}",
1534                    strategy_id="howlinstinct_semantic/v1",
1535                )
1536            if self.semantic_settings.strict and semantic.status in INTEGRITY_FAILURES:
1537                semantic_blocked = True
1538        avoid_id = self._normalize(avoid_resource_id) if avoid_resource_id else None
1539        candidates.sort(
1540            key=lambda profile: self._ranking_key(profile, rank_recommendation, avoid_id)
1541        )
1542        if semantic_blocked:
1543            candidates = []
1544        selected: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
1545        if explicit_id:
1546            selected = next(
1547                (profile for profile in candidates if profile.resource_id == explicit_id),
1548                None,
1549            )
1550            if selected is None:
1551                candidates = []
1552        elif candidates:
1553            selected = candidates[0]
1554
1555        status = (
1556            ResourceSelectionStatus.SELECTED
1557            if selected is not None
1558            else ResourceSelectionStatus.BLOCKED
1559        )
1560        identities = [self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in candidates]
1561        selected_identity = self._resource_identity(selected) if selected else None
1562        if selected_identity is not None:
1563            identities = [selected_identity] + [
1564                identity for identity in identities
1565                if identity.resource_id != selected_identity.resource_id
1566            ]
1567        if semantic is not None:
1568            semantic = replace(
1569                semantic,
1570                final_selection=selected_identity.resource_id if selected_identity else None,
1571                # Disagreement is semantic vs deterministic, so active mode
1572                # (where the final pick follows System 1) does not hide it.
1573                disagreement=(
1574                    None
1575                    if semantic.selected_resource_id is None or recommendation.resource_id is None
1576                    else semantic.selected_resource_id != recommendation.resource_id
1577                ),
1578            )
1579        blocked_reason = None
1580        if selected is None:
1581            blocked_reason = (
1582                "SEMANTIC_RECOMMENDATION_FAILED"
1583                if semantic_blocked
1584                else "NO_ELIGIBLE_AI_RESOURCE"
1585            )
1586        return ResourceSelectionDecision(
1587            task_class=task.task_class,
1588            role=role,
1589            required_capabilities=required,
1590            status=status,
1591            registered_resources=registered,
1592            eligible_resources=identities,
1593            exclusions=exclusions,
1594            selected=selected_identity,
1595            selection_policy=self.policy.strategy,
1596            economic_policy=self.policy.model_dump(),
1597            cognitive_recommendation=recommendation,
1598            capacity_before=self.get_all_statuses(),
1599            explicit_override=explicit_id is not None,
1600            blocked_reason=blocked_reason,
1601            semantic_recommendation=semantic.to_dict() if semantic is not None else None,
1602        )
1603
1604    @staticmethod
1605    def _workspace_trust_block(resource_id: str, task: TaskSpec) -> Optional[str]:
1606        workspace = getattr(task, "repository", None)
1607        if not workspace or not Path(str(workspace)).is_absolute():
1608            return None
1609        from howlplane.control_plane.agent_readiness import workspace_blocked
1610        return workspace_blocked(resource_id, workspace)
1611
1612    def select_candidates(
1613        self,
1614        task_category: str = "code_heavy",
1615        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
1616        preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None,
1617        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1618        role: str = "implementation",
1619    ) -> List[str]:
1620        """Compatibility API returning the new pipeline's ordered candidates.
1621
1622        `role` is the role the candidates are actually for. It used to be
1623        hardcoded to "implementation", so reviewer failover picked its fallback
1624        pool using implementation capability requirements rather than the review
1625        role's -- the wrong question for the candidate it was choosing.
1626        """
1627        if task is None or self._legacy_mode:
1628            preference = TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES.get(
1629                task_category,
1630                TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES["code_heavy"],
1631            )
1632            result = []
1633            for agent_id in preference:
1634                normalized = self._normalize(agent_id)
1635                if (
1636                    task is not None
1637                    and normalized in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1638                    and not is_task_local_eligible(task)
1639                ):
1640                    continue
1641                if self.get_status(normalized) in {
1642                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE,
1643                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN,
1644                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
1645                }:
1646                    result.append(normalized)
1647            if preferred_agent:
1648                preferred = self._normalize(preferred_agent)
1649                if preferred in result:
1650                    result.remove(preferred)
1651                    result.insert(0, preferred)
1652            if avoid_provider:
1653                avoided = self._normalize(avoid_provider)
1654                if avoided in result:
1655                    result.remove(avoided)
1656                    result.append(avoided)
1657            return list(dict.fromkeys(result))
1658        decision = self.select_resource(
1659            task,
1660            role=role,
1661            explicit_resource_id=preferred_agent,
1662            avoid_resource_id=avoid_provider,
1663        )
1664        return [identity.resource_id for identity in decision.eligible_resources]
1665
1666    def select_reviewers(
1667        self,
1668        implementing_agent_id: str,
1669        required_roles: List[str],
1670        allow_same_provider: bool = False,
1671        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1672    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], bool]:
1673        """Selects role-capable reviewers and reports identity diversity honestly."""
1674        implementation_id = self._normalize(implementing_agent_id)
1675        if self._legacy_mode:
1676            available = [
1677                profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1678                for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1679                if self.get_status(profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id)
1680                == ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
1681            ]
1682            distinct = [item for item in available if item != implementation_id]
1683            mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1684            diversity = True
1685            for index, role in enumerate(required_roles):
1686                role_candidates = distinct
1687                if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES:
1688                    role_candidates = [
1689                        item for item in role_candidates if item not in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1690                    ]
1691                if role_candidates:
1692                    mapping[role] = role_candidates[index % len(role_candidates)]
1693                else:
1694                    mapping[role] = implementation_id
1695                    diversity = False
1696            return mapping, diversity
1697        implementation = self.registry.get_resource(implementation_id)
1698        review_task = task or TaskSpec(
1699            task_id="REVIEW-SELECTION",
1700            repository="unknown",
1701            objective="Review an implementation diff",
1702            task_class="other",
1703            risk_level="medium",
1704        )
1705        mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1706        diversity = True
1707        used: Set[str] = set()
1708        for role in required_roles:
1709            decision = self.select_resource(
1710                review_task,
1711                role=role,
1712                avoid_resource_id=implementation_id,
1713            )
1714            eligible = [
1715                self.registry.get_resource(identity.resource_id)
1716                for identity in decision.eligible_resources
1717            ]
1718            eligible = [profile for profile in eligible if profile is not None]
1719            distinct = [
1720                profile for profile in eligible
1721                if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1722                and implementation is not None
1723                and profile.provider_id != implementation.provider_id
1724            ]
1725            choices = distinct or [
1726                profile for profile in eligible if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1727            ]
1728            if choices:
1729                unused = [profile for profile in choices if profile.resource_id not in used]
1730                chosen = (unused or choices)[0]
1731                mapping[role] = chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id
1732                used.add(chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id)
1733                if chosen not in distinct:
1734                    diversity = False
1735            elif implementation is not None:
1736                mapping[role] = implementation_id
1737                diversity = False
1738            elif allow_same_provider and decision.selected:
1739                mapping[role] = decision.selected.resource_id
1740                diversity = False
1741        return mapping, diversity

Single owner for resource readiness, capacity, and final selection.

@classmethod
def from_settings( cls, settings: Any, *, registry: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.agent_registry.AgentRegistry] = None, state_path: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None, read_only: bool = False, probe_on_start: bool = True) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderPoolManager: 
490    @classmethod
491    def from_settings(
492        cls,
493        settings: Any,
494        *,
495        registry: Optional[AgentRegistry] = None,
496        state_path: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None,
497        read_only: bool = False,
498        probe_on_start: bool = True,
499    ) -> "ProviderPoolManager":
500        """Builds the production pool with deterministic legacy migration."""
501        actual_registry = registry or AgentRegistry()
502        configured = dict(settings.providers)
503        if not configured:
504            if settings.operating_mode == "local_only":
505                configured = {"local_ollama": ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)}
506            else:
507                configured = {
508                    profile.resource_id: ProviderResourceSettings(enabled=True)
509                    for profile in actual_registry.list_resources()
510                }
511        return cls(
512            registry=actual_registry,
513            resources=configured,
514            policy=settings.provider_policy,
515            operating_mode=settings.operating_mode,
516            state_path=state_path,
517            read_only=read_only,
518            probe_on_start=probe_on_start,
519            semantic_recommender=build_semantic_recommender(settings.semantic_recommendation),
520            semantic_settings=settings.semantic_recommendation,
521        )

716    def set_status(

735            state.unavailable_reason = None
736        state.last_checked = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
737        state.observed_at = state.last_checked
738        if event:
739            state.exhaustion_event = event
740        self._persist()

796            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
797            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
798            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
799            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
800            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
801            ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
802        }
