@staticmethod
def classify_result( agent_id: str, result: howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentExecutionResult) -> howlplane.control_plane.resource_models.ProviderFailureClass: 
826    @staticmethod
827    def classify_result(
828        agent_id: str,
829        result: AgentExecutionResult,
830    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
831        """Normalizes availability separately from engineering results."""
832        if result.success:
833            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
834        resource_id = AgentBackendRegistry.normalize_agent_id(agent_id)
835        combined = "\n".join(
836            [result.error_message or "", result.stderr or "", result.stdout or ""]
837        ).lower()
838        # Structural execution evidence outranks transcript text. A long agent
839        # transcript is arbitrary third-party content that routinely contains the
840        # very phrases these markers look for, so where the harness observed the
841        # process directly, that observation wins (SLOPFIX-03).
842        metadata = result.metadata or {}
843        if metadata.get(WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_KEY) == WATCHDOG_TERMINATION_STALL:
844            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED
845        launch_outcome = metadata.get(LAUNCH_OUTCOME_KEY)
846        if launch_outcome in (LAUNCH_OUTCOME_NOT_INSTALLED, LAUNCH_OUTCOME_SPAWN_FAILED):
847            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
848        # A harness-sourced or budget-derived timeout is this process stopping
849        # the provider at our own budget (either directly via harness kill or
850        # via a harness-derived print timeout). Nothing was observed about
851        # reachability, so it is an execution budget result, not a transport
852        # failure. Transcript-sourced timeouts without budget derivation still
853        # fall through to the transport branch below, where a provider genuinely
854        # reporting that it could not reach its service is classified as
855        # TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE and benched (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
856        # A vendor trust refusal opens the output before any work happens. It
857        # outranks a deadline only when positively identified for this CLI: a
858        # session that sat on its own trust prompt until our budget expired was
859        # blocked by the folder, not slow (see workspace_trust).
860        if result_is_trust_refusal(resource_id, result):
861            return ProviderFailureClass.WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED
862        if (
863            metadata.get(TIMEOUT_SOURCE_KEY) in (TIMEOUT_SOURCE_HARNESS, TIMEOUT_SOURCE_BUDGET)
864            or metadata.get(BUDGET_DERIVED_KEY) is True
865        ):
866            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
867        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and result.exit_code == 127:
868            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
869
870        # A provider's exact terminal error is stronger than evidence collected
871        # earlier in its session. In particular, a hard capacity stop must not
872        # be hidden by an earlier denied tool. However, arbitrary trailing prose
873        # in stdout must NEVER override a structured denial: only authenticated
874        # structured metadata or explicit non-zero exit stderr can outrank it.
875        if metadata.get(TOOL_PERMISSION_KEY) == TOOL_PERMISSION_DENIED:
876            structured_terminal = _classify_structured_terminal_hard_failure(result)
877            if structured_terminal is not None:
878                return structured_terminal
879            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
880
881        # A machine-readable error envelope is the strongest signal a provider
882        # can give about why it stopped, and it does not depend on where the
883        # message happens to sit in the output. Devin's quota error is a
884        # multi-line JSON blob whose last non-empty line is "}", so the
885        # anchored line matching below cannot see it at all, whatever patterns
886        # are added (issues.md #15).
887        envelope_failure = _classify_structured_error_envelope(result)
888        if envelope_failure is not None:
889            return envelope_failure
890
891        terminal_hard_failure = _classify_terminal_hard_failure(result)
892        if terminal_hard_failure is not None:
893            return terminal_hard_failure
894
895        # A provider that demonstrably started cannot be a missing executable,
896        # whatever its session log says about commands that were not found.
897        # Backends that stamp no markers keep the older text-based behavior, with
898        # one correction: a timeout verdict is the more specific signal and so
899        # outranks the substring scan. Exit 127 remains a legacy launch verdict
900        # only when no structural launched marker contradicts it.
901        if launch_outcome != LAUNCH_OUTCOME_LAUNCHED and (
902            not result.timed_out and any(marker in combined for marker in (
903                "command not found", "binary not found", "not installed",
904            ))
905        ):
906            return ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE
907        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
908            "requires approval", "require approval", "permission denied",
909            "requires permission", "execution permission required", "execution_permission_required",
910            "needs approval", "approve bash execution",
911            # Trust prose that is not a positively identified refusal (above)
912            # keeps its conservative, pre-existing permission classification.
913            "workspace trust required", "trust the current workspace", "pass --trust",
914            "untrusted workspace",
915        )):
916            return ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED
917        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
918            "authentication required", "not authenticated", "login required",
919            "unauthorized", "invalid api key",
920        )):
921            return ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED
922        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
923            "429 too many requests", "rate_limit", "rate limit", "rate limited",
924        )):
925            return ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED
926        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
927            "quota exhausted", "quota exceeded", "insufficient_quota",
928            "credits exhausted", "insufficient funds", "resource exhausted",
929        )):
930            return ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
931        session_patterns = EXHAUSTION_PATTERNS.get(resource_id, []) + [
932            "usage limit",
933            "session limit",
934            "individual quota reached",
935            "quota reached",
936            "upgrade your subscription",
937            "out of capacity",
938        ]
939        if any(marker in combined for marker in session_patterns):
940            return ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT
941        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
942            "malformed", "invalid json", "invalid yaml", "parse error",
943        )):
944            return ProviderFailureClass.MALFORMED_OUTPUT
945        if result.timed_out or any(marker in combined for marker in (
946            "connection refused", "transport unavailable", "network unreachable",
947            "timed out", "timeout waiting for response", "request timed out",
948            "connection timed out", "gateway timeout", "read timeout",
949            "operation timed out", "deadline exceeded", "timeout after",
950        )):
951            return ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE
952        if any(marker in combined for marker in (
953            "provider unavailable", "service unavailable", "overloaded_error", "outage",
954        )):
955            return ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE
956        return ProviderFailureClass.ENGINEERING_FAILURE

Normalizes availability separately from engineering results.

def record_result( self, agent_id: str, result: howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentExecutionResult, task_id: Optional[str] = None, role: Optional[str] = None) -> howlplane.control_plane.resource_models.ProviderFailureClass: 
 958    def record_result(
 959        self,
 960        agent_id: str,
 961        result: AgentExecutionResult,
 962        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
 963        role: Optional[str] = None,
 964    ) -> ProviderFailureClass:
 965        """Updates shared state only when the observed result warrants it."""
 966        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
 967        state = self._provider_states.get(resource_id)
 968        if state is None:
 969            raise KeyError(f"Unknown resource '{resource_id}'.")
 970        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
 971        profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
 972        if (
 973            profile is not None
 974            and profile.economic_class == EconomicClass.METERED_API.value
 975        ):
 976            state.metered_invocation_count += 1
 977            self._persist()
 978        if result.success:
 979            state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
 980            state.normalized_failure_class = None
 981            state.unavailable_reason = None
 982            state.exhaustion_event = None
 983            state.success_count += 1
 984            state.total_duration_seconds += result.duration_seconds
 985            state.last_success_at = now.isoformat()
 986            state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
 987            state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
 988            state.retry_after = None
 989            if role and role in state.role_exclusions:
 990                state.role_exclusions.pop(role, None)
 991            self._persist()
 992            return ProviderFailureClass.UNKNOWN
 993
 994        failure_class = self.classify_failure(resource_id, result)
 995        metadata = result.metadata or {}
 996        if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED:
 997            # One untrusted folder says nothing about the resource anywhere
 998            # else: availability, cooldowns, and role eligibility are unchanged.
 999            state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
1000            state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
1001            self._persist()
1002            return failure_class
1003
1004        state.consecutive_failures += 1
1005        state.last_failure_at = now.isoformat()
1006        state.last_checked = now.isoformat()
1007        state.observed_at = now.isoformat()
1008        state.normalized_failure_class = failure_class.value
1009        state.unavailable_reason = failure_class.value
1010
1011        if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_PERMISSION_REQUIRED:
1012            target_role = role or "unknown"
1013            state.role_exclusions[target_role] = failure_class.value
1014            if self._is_review_role(target_role):
1015                state.role_exclusions["review"] = failure_class.value
1016            self._persist()
1017            return failure_class
1018
1019        # EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED previously stayed out of this map to avoid
1020        # penalizing a healthy resource for our own harness deadline. The live
1021        # incident showed repeatedly burning ~10-minute slots on the same provider
1022        # while another was available, so a bounded DEGRADED cooldown is recorded
1023        # instead. DEGRADED still leaves the provider eligible, just deprioritized,
1024        # and expires after the normal transient cooldown.
1025        availability_map = {
1026            ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
1027            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1028            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.SESSION_EXHAUSTED,
1029            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RATE_LIMITED,
1030            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1031            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1032            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1033            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1034            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1035        }
1036        if failure_class in availability_map:
1037            state.status = availability_map[failure_class]
1038            # Every capacity condition expires. QUOTA_EXHAUSTED was absent from
1039            # this set, so a quota event had no `retry_after` at all and the
1040            # resource stayed unavailable until someone called reset_resource --
1041            # a single historical quota event permanently removing a provider
1042            # from the pool. It now expires on its own, longer clock: a quota is
1043            # billed over a day or a week, so re-probing it on the transient
1044            # cooldown would spend attempts proving what is already known
1045            # (issues.md #15).
1046            transient = {
1047                ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1048                ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1049                ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1050                ProviderFailureClass.EXECUTION_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
1051            }
1052            cooldown = None
1053            if failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT:
1054                cooldown = getattr(
1055                    self.policy, "session_cooldown_seconds", None
1056                ) or 14400
1057            elif failure_class in transient:
1058                cooldown = self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1059            elif failure_class is ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED:
1060                cooldown = getattr(
1061                    self.policy, "quota_cooldown_seconds", None
1062                ) or self.policy.cooldown_seconds
1063            explicit_retry_seconds = metadata.get(PROVIDER_RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS_KEY)
1064            if isinstance(explicit_retry_seconds, int) and explicit_retry_seconds >= 0:
1065                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=explicit_retry_seconds)).isoformat()
1066            elif cooldown:
1067                state.retry_after = (now + timedelta(seconds=cooldown)).isoformat()
1068            state.exhaustion_event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1069                agent_id=resource_id,
1070                failure_type={
1071                    ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT: "session_limit",
1072                    ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED: "rate_limit",
1073                    ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: "quota_exhausted",
1074                    ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: "authentication_required",
1075                    ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_STALLED: "stalled",
1076                }.get(failure_class, "unavailable"),
1077                raw_error=(result.stderr or result.error_message or failure_class.value).strip(),
1078                task_id=task_id,
1079            )
1080            self._persist()
1081        return failure_class

Updates shared state only when the observed result warrants it.

def detect_exhaustion( self, agent_id: str, result: howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution.AgentExecutionResult, task_id: Optional[str] = None, role: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderExhaustionEvent]: 
1083    def detect_exhaustion(
1084        self,
1085        agent_id: str,
1086        result: AgentExecutionResult,
1087        task_id: Optional[str] = None,
1088        role: Optional[str] = None,
1089    ) -> Optional[ProviderExhaustionEvent]:
1090        """Compatibility wrapper returning events only for availability failures."""
1091        resource_id = self._normalize(agent_id)
1092        if resource_id in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS:
1093            reason = (result.error_message or "").upper()
1094            if reason == "RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED":
1095                event = ProviderExhaustionEvent(
1096                    agent_id=resource_id,
1097                    failure_type="unavailable",
1098                    raw_error=result.stderr or reason,
1099                    task_id=task_id,
1100                )
1101                self.set_status(
1102                    resource_id,
1103                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.RESOURCE_CONSTRAINED,
1104                    event,
1105                )
1106                return event
1107        failure_class = self.record_result(agent_id, result, task_id=task_id, role=role)
1108        availability_classes = {
1109            ProviderFailureClass.QUOTA_EXHAUSTED,
1110            ProviderFailureClass.SESSION_LIMIT,
1111            ProviderFailureClass.RATE_LIMITED,
1112            ProviderFailureClass.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED,
1113            ProviderFailureClass.PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE,
1114            ProviderFailureClass.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE,
1115            ProviderFailureClass.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1116        }
1117        if failure_class not in availability_classes:
1118            return None
1119        return self._provider_states[self._normalize(agent_id)].exhaustion_event

Compatibility wrapper returning events only for availability failures.

def reset_resource( self, resource_id: str, *, reprobe: bool = True) -> howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderStatus: 
1121    def reset_resource(self, resource_id: str, *, reprobe: bool = True) -> ProviderStatus:
1122        """Clears only current availability state for one configured resource."""
1123        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1124        profile = self.registry.get_resource(normalized)
1125        config = self.resources.get(normalized)
1126        if profile is None or config is None:
1127            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is not configured.")
1128        if not config.enabled:
1129            raise ProviderConfigurationError(f"Resource '{resource_id}' is operator disabled.")
1130        state = self._provider_states[normalized]
1131        state.status = ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN
1132        state.normalized_failure_class = None
1133        state.exhaustion_event = None
1134        state.retry_after = None
1135        state.reset_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
1136        state.unavailable_reason = None
1137        state.role_exclusions.clear()
1138        if reprobe and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1139            self._apply_readiness(normalized, profile, state)
1140        self._persist()
1141        return state

Clears only current availability state for one configured resource.

def reset_transient_exhaustion(self) -> None: 
1143    def reset_transient_exhaustion(self) -> None:
1144        """Compatibility reset using bounded non-generative readiness probes."""
1145        for resource_id, resource_config in self.resources.items():
1146            if resource_config.enabled:
1147                profile = self.registry.get_resource(resource_id)
1148                if profile and not self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1149                    self.reset_resource(resource_id, reprobe=True)

Compatibility reset using bounded non-generative readiness probes.

def check_capacity_exclusion(self, resource_id: str, role: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]: 
1201    def check_capacity_exclusion(
1202        self,
1203        resource_id: str,
1204        role: Optional[str] = None,
1205    ) -> Optional[str]:
1206        """Returns the capacity block or role exclusion reason for a resource, if any."""
1207        normalized = self._normalize(resource_id)
1208        state = self._provider_states.get(normalized)
1209        if state is None:
1210            return "UNKNOWN_RESOURCE"
1211        general = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1212        if general:
1213            return general
1214        if role:
1215            if role in state.role_exclusions:
1216                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}"
1217            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1218                return f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}"
1219        return None

Returns the capacity block or role exclusion reason for a resource, if any.

Replaces semantic policy, for example from a CLI override.

def select_resource( self, task: howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec, *, role: str, explicit_resource_id: Optional[str] = None, avoid_resource_id: Optional[str] = None, exclude_resource_ids: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None) -> howlplane.control_plane.resource_models.ResourceSelectionDecision: 
1407    def select_resource(
1408        self,
1409        task: TaskSpec,
1410        *,
1411        role: str,
1412        explicit_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1413        avoid_resource_id: Optional[str] = None,
1414        exclude_resource_ids: Optional[Iterable[str]] = None,
1415    ) -> ResourceSelectionDecision:
1416        """Applies hard filtering, economics, recommendation, and stable tie break.
1417
1418        ``avoid_resource_id`` is a soft preference that only demotes a resource in
1419        the ranking. ``exclude_resource_ids`` is a hard prohibition, used by
1420        bounded failover so a resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt cannot
1421        be re-offered and dead-end the loop.
1422        """
1423        required = self._required_capabilities(task, role)
1424        excluded_ids = {
1425            self._normalize(item) for item in (exclude_resource_ids or []) if item
1426        }
1427        registered = [
1428            self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1429        ]
1430        exclusions: List[ResourceExclusion] = []
1431        candidates: List[AgentProfile] = []
1432        task_forbids_egress = self._task_forbids_egress(task)
1433
1434        def exclude(profile: AgentProfile, reason: str, stage: str, detail=None):
1435            exclusions.append(ResourceExclusion(
1436                resource_id=profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id,
1437                reason=reason,
1438                stage=stage,
1439                detail=detail,
1440            ))
1441
1442        for profile in self.registry.list_resources():
1443            resource_id = profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1444            resource_config = self.resources.get(resource_id)
1445            state = self._provider_states[resource_id]
1446            if resource_config is None:
1447                exclude(profile, "NOT_CONFIGURED", "operator_permission")
1448                continue
1449            if not resource_config.enabled:
1450                exclude(profile, "OPERATOR_DISABLED", "operator_permission")
1451                continue
1452            if self._egress_forbidden(profile):
1453                exclude(profile, "EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1454                continue
1455            if task_forbids_egress and profile.locality != ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1456                exclude(profile, "TASK_EGRESS_FORBIDDEN", "egress_policy")
1457                continue
1458            self._recover_capacity_if_due(resource_id, profile, state)
1459            if state.readiness in {
1460                ReadinessStatus.MISSING_EXECUTABLE,
1461                ReadinessStatus.AUTH_REQUIRED,
1462                ReadinessStatus.UNREACHABLE,
1463                ReadinessStatus.UNAVAILABLE,
1464            }:
1465                exclude(profile, state.readiness.value, "runtime_readiness")
1466                continue
1467            if role not in profile.roles and not (
1468                self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in profile.roles
1469            ):
1470                exclude(profile, "ROLE_NOT_SUPPORTED", "capability")
1471                continue
1472            missing = [cap for cap in required if not self._has_capability(profile, cap)]
1473            if missing:
1474                exclude(
1475                    profile,
1476                    "MISSING_REQUIRED_CAPABILITY",
1477                    "capability",
1478                    ",".join(missing),
1479                )
1480                continue
1481            if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES and profile.locality == ResourceLocality.LOCAL.value:
1482                exclude(profile, "LOCAL_REVIEW_AUTHORITY_FORBIDDEN", "authority")
1483                continue
1484            capacity_reason = self._capacity_exclusion(state.status)
1485            if capacity_reason:
1486                exclude(profile, capacity_reason, "capacity")
1487                continue
1488            if role in state.role_exclusions:
1489                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions[role]}", "capacity")
1490                continue
1491            if self._is_review_role(role) and "review" in state.role_exclusions:
1492                exclude(profile, f"ROLE_EXCLUDED:{state.role_exclusions['review']}", "capacity")
1493                continue
1494            if resource_id in excluded_ids:
1495                exclude(profile, "ALREADY_ATTEMPTED", "failover_policy")
1496                continue
1497            trust_block = self._workspace_trust_block(resource_id, task)
1498            if trust_block:
1499                # Scoped to this task's workspace: the resource stays eligible elsewhere.
1500                exclude(profile, "WORKSPACE_TRUST_REQUIRED", "workspace_trust", trust_block)
1501                continue
1502            economics = EconomicClass(profile.economic_class or EconomicClass.UNKNOWN)
1503            if economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API and not self.policy.allow_paid_api:
1504                exclude(profile, "PAID_API_FORBIDDEN", "economic_policy")
1505                continue
1506            if (
1507                economics == EconomicClass.METERED_API
1508                and self.policy.max_metered_invocations is not None
1509                and state.metered_invocation_count
1510                >= self.policy.max_metered_invocations
1511            ):
1512                exclude(profile, "METERED_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED", "economic_policy")
1513                continue
1514            candidates.append(profile)
1515
1516        recommendation = self._recommend(task, role, candidates)
1517        supplied_explicit = explicit_resource_id or task.preferred_agent
1518        explicit_id = self._normalize(supplied_explicit) if supplied_explicit else None
1519        semantic = self._semantic_assess(
1520            task,
1521            role,
1522            candidates,
1523            explicit_override=explicit_id is not None,
1524            task_forbids_egress=task_forbids_egress,
1525            deterministic=recommendation,
1526        )
1527        rank_recommendation = recommendation
1528        semantic_blocked = False
1529        if semantic is not None:
1530            if semantic.applied and semantic.selected_resource_id:
1531                rank_recommendation = CognitiveRecommendation(
1532                    resource_id=semantic.selected_resource_id,
1533                    reason=f"HowlInstinct judgment accepted by Plane policy: {semantic.reason}",
1534                    strategy_id="howlinstinct_semantic/v1",
1535                )
1536            if self.semantic_settings.strict and semantic.status in INTEGRITY_FAILURES:
1537                semantic_blocked = True
1538        avoid_id = self._normalize(avoid_resource_id) if avoid_resource_id else None
1539        candidates.sort(
1540            key=lambda profile: self._ranking_key(profile, rank_recommendation, avoid_id)
1541        )
1542        if semantic_blocked:
1543            candidates = []
1544        selected: Optional[AgentProfile] = None
1545        if explicit_id:
1546            selected = next(
1547                (profile for profile in candidates if profile.resource_id == explicit_id),
1548                None,
1549            )
1550            if selected is None:
1551                candidates = []
1552        elif candidates:
1553            selected = candidates[0]
1554
1555        status = (
1556            ResourceSelectionStatus.SELECTED
1557            if selected is not None
1558            else ResourceSelectionStatus.BLOCKED
1559        )
1560        identities = [self._resource_identity(profile) for profile in candidates]
1561        selected_identity = self._resource_identity(selected) if selected else None
1562        if selected_identity is not None:
1563            identities = [selected_identity] + [
1564                identity for identity in identities
1565                if identity.resource_id != selected_identity.resource_id
1566            ]
1567        if semantic is not None:
1568            semantic = replace(
1569                semantic,
1570                final_selection=selected_identity.resource_id if selected_identity else None,
1571                # Disagreement is semantic vs deterministic, so active mode
1572                # (where the final pick follows System 1) does not hide it.
1573                disagreement=(
1574                    None
1575                    if semantic.selected_resource_id is None or recommendation.resource_id is None
1576                    else semantic.selected_resource_id != recommendation.resource_id
1577                ),
1578            )
1579        blocked_reason = None
1580        if selected is None:
1581            blocked_reason = (
1582                "SEMANTIC_RECOMMENDATION_FAILED"
1583                if semantic_blocked
1584                else "NO_ELIGIBLE_AI_RESOURCE"
1585            )
1586        return ResourceSelectionDecision(
1587            task_class=task.task_class,
1588            role=role,
1589            required_capabilities=required,
1590            status=status,
1591            registered_resources=registered,
1592            eligible_resources=identities,
1593            exclusions=exclusions,
1594            selected=selected_identity,
1595            selection_policy=self.policy.strategy,
1596            economic_policy=self.policy.model_dump(),
1597            cognitive_recommendation=recommendation,
1598            capacity_before=self.get_all_statuses(),
1599            explicit_override=explicit_id is not None,
1600            blocked_reason=blocked_reason,
1601            semantic_recommendation=semantic.to_dict() if semantic is not None else None,
1602        )

Applies hard filtering, economics, recommendation, and stable tie break.

avoid_resource_id is a soft preference that only demotes a resource in the ranking. exclude_resource_ids is a hard prohibition, used by bounded failover so a resource whose cooldown elapsed mid-attempt cannot be re-offered and dead-end the loop.

def select_candidates( self, task_category: str = 'code_heavy', avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None, preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None, task: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec] = None, role: str = 'implementation') -> List[str]: 
1612    def select_candidates(
1613        self,
1614        task_category: str = "code_heavy",
1615        avoid_provider: Optional[str] = None,
1616        preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None,
1617        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1618        role: str = "implementation",
1619    ) -> List[str]:
1620        """Compatibility API returning the new pipeline's ordered candidates.
1621
1622        `role` is the role the candidates are actually for. It used to be
1623        hardcoded to "implementation", so reviewer failover picked its fallback
1624        pool using implementation capability requirements rather than the review
1625        role's -- the wrong question for the candidate it was choosing.
1626        """
1627        if task is None or self._legacy_mode:
1628            preference = TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES.get(
1629                task_category,
1630                TASK_SUITABILITY_PREFERENCES["code_heavy"],
1631            )
1632            result = []
1633            for agent_id in preference:
1634                normalized = self._normalize(agent_id)
1635                if (
1636                    task is not None
1637                    and normalized in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1638                    and not is_task_local_eligible(task)
1639                ):
1640                    continue
1641                if self.get_status(normalized) in {
1642                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE,
1643                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.UNKNOWN,
1644                    ProviderAvailabilityStatus.DEGRADED,
1645                }:
1646                    result.append(normalized)
1647            if preferred_agent:
1648                preferred = self._normalize(preferred_agent)
1649                if preferred in result:
1650                    result.remove(preferred)
1651                    result.insert(0, preferred)
1652            if avoid_provider:
1653                avoided = self._normalize(avoid_provider)
1654                if avoided in result:
1655                    result.remove(avoided)
1656                    result.append(avoided)
1657            return list(dict.fromkeys(result))
1658        decision = self.select_resource(
1659            task,
1660            role=role,
1661            explicit_resource_id=preferred_agent,
1662            avoid_resource_id=avoid_provider,
1663        )
1664        return [identity.resource_id for identity in decision.eligible_resources]

Compatibility API returning the new pipeline's ordered candidates.

role is the role the candidates are actually for. It used to be hardcoded to "implementation", so reviewer failover picked its fallback pool using implementation capability requirements rather than the review role's -- the wrong question for the candidate it was choosing.

def select_reviewers( self, implementing_agent_id: str, required_roles: List[str], allow_same_provider: bool = False, task: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec] = None) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], bool]: 
1666    def select_reviewers(
1667        self,
1668        implementing_agent_id: str,
1669        required_roles: List[str],
1670        allow_same_provider: bool = False,
1671        task: Optional[TaskSpec] = None,
1672    ) -> Tuple[Dict[str, str], bool]:
1673        """Selects role-capable reviewers and reports identity diversity honestly."""
1674        implementation_id = self._normalize(implementing_agent_id)
1675        if self._legacy_mode:
1676            available = [
1677                profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id
1678                for profile in self.registry.list_resources()
1679                if self.get_status(profile.resource_id or profile.agent_id)
1680                == ProviderAvailabilityStatus.AVAILABLE
1681            ]
1682            distinct = [item for item in available if item != implementation_id]
1683            mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1684            diversity = True
1685            for index, role in enumerate(required_roles):
1686                role_candidates = distinct
1687                if role in LOCAL_INELIGIBLE_REVIEWER_ROLES:
1688                    role_candidates = [
1689                        item for item in role_candidates if item not in LOCAL_PROVIDER_IDS
1690                    ]
1691                if role_candidates:
1692                    mapping[role] = role_candidates[index % len(role_candidates)]
1693                else:
1694                    mapping[role] = implementation_id
1695                    diversity = False
1696            return mapping, diversity
1697        implementation = self.registry.get_resource(implementation_id)
1698        review_task = task or TaskSpec(
1699            task_id="REVIEW-SELECTION",
1700            repository="unknown",
1701            objective="Review an implementation diff",
1702            task_class="other",
1703            risk_level="medium",
1704        )
1705        mapping: Dict[str, str] = {}
1706        diversity = True
1707        used: Set[str] = set()
1708        for role in required_roles:
1709            decision = self.select_resource(
1710                review_task,
1711                role=role,
1712                avoid_resource_id=implementation_id,
1713            )
1714            eligible = [
1715                self.registry.get_resource(identity.resource_id)
1716                for identity in decision.eligible_resources
1717            ]
1718            eligible = [profile for profile in eligible if profile is not None]
1719            distinct = [
1720                profile for profile in eligible
1721                if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1722                and implementation is not None
1723                and profile.provider_id != implementation.provider_id
1724            ]
1725            choices = distinct or [
1726                profile for profile in eligible if profile.resource_id != implementation_id
1727            ]
1728            if choices:
1729                unused = [profile for profile in choices if profile.resource_id not in used]
1730                chosen = (unused or choices)[0]
1731                mapping[role] = chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id
1732                used.add(chosen.resource_id or chosen.agent_id)
1733                if chosen not in distinct:
1734                    diversity = False
1735            elif implementation is not None:
1736                mapping[role] = implementation_id
1737                diversity = False
1738            elif allow_same_provider and decision.selected:
1739                mapping[role] = decision.selected.resource_id
1740                diversity = False
1741        return mapping, diversity

Selects role-capable reviewers and reports identity diversity honestly.

@dataclass
class TaskSpec(howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.DataClassSerializationMixin): 
129@dataclass
130class TaskSpec(DataClassSerializationMixin):
131    """Represents a discrete engineering task handled by the multi-agent control plane."""
132
133    task_id: str
134    repository: str
135    objective: str
136    acceptance_criteria: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
137    constraints: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
138    task_class: str = "feature"
139    risk_level: str = "medium"
140    required_skills: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
141    recommended_reasoning_tier: str = "tier_2"
142    preferred_agent: Optional[str] = None
143    recommended_agent: Optional[str] = None
144    # Durable audit answer to "who produced the work this task is governing".
145    # Provisional while implementation is still moving between resources, and
146    # pinned to the effective implementer the moment implementation settles.
147    # It is NOT a dispatch slot: nothing may overwrite it to tell a backend
148    # which resource to invoke, which is exactly how a reviewer's provider id
149    # ended up here on HOWLFRAM-BUG-52 (issues.md #16). Use
150    # `dispatch_resource_id` / `dispatch_target` for that.
151    actual_agent: Optional[str] = None
152    # The single authoritative effective-implementer identity (issues.md #16).
153    # Written once implementation settles -- on success, on promotion of a
154    # retained candidate, and on recovery after an interruption -- and never
155    # written by any review, remediation or dispatch path. `actual_agent`
156    # mirrors it so durable task metadata, reviewer-independence records and
157    # the final summary cannot disagree about who produced the candidate.
158    effective_implementer_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
159    # Transient: which resource the *next* backend invocation represents.
160    # Reviewer and implementation failover both rewrite this per attempt; it
161    # carries no audit meaning and is deliberately excluded from every
162    # "who implemented this" question.
163    dispatch_resource_id: Optional[str] = None
164    is_override: Optional[bool] = None
165    override_reason: Optional[str] = None
166    allowed_tools: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
167    prohibited_actions: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
168    verification_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
169    reviewer_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
170    human_approval_requirements: List[str] = field(default_factory=list)
171    current_state: str = "discovered"
172    task_journal_path: Optional[str] = None
173    # Exact repo-relative paths this task may commit (#59.2 Phase 8). Empty
174    # (the default) means unrestricted -- existing serialized task.yaml files
175    # without this key deserialize unaffected. When non-empty,

185    def dispatch_target(self) -> Optional[str]:
186        """Which resource the next backend invocation represents.
187
188        Falls back to `actual_agent` so a caller that never set a dispatch
189        target (implementation paths that construct a fresh TaskSpec per
190        candidate) keeps its existing behaviour. Being a property rather than
191        a field, it is never serialized.
192        """
193        return self.dispatch_resource_id or self.actual_agent

195    def validate(self) -> None:
196        """Validates internal fields against allowed enums and non-empty constraints."""
197        if not self.task_id or not isinstance(self.task_id, str):
198            raise TaskSpecValidationError("task_id must be a non-empty string")
199        if not self.repository or not isinstance(self.repository, str):
200            raise TaskSpecValidationError("repository must be a non-empty string")
201        if not self.objective or not isinstance(self.objective, str):
202            raise TaskSpecValidationError("objective must be a non-empty string")
203        if self.task_class not in VALID_TASK_CLASSES:
204            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
205                f"task_class '{self.task_class}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_CLASSES)}"
206            )
207        if self.risk_level not in VALID_RISK_LEVELS:
208            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
209                f"risk_level '{self.risk_level}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_RISK_LEVELS)}"
210            )
211        if self.recommended_reasoning_tier not in VALID_REASONING_TIERS:
212            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
213                f"recommended_reasoning_tier '{self.recommended_reasoning_tier}' invalid."
214            )
215        if self.current_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
216            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
217                f"current_state '{self.current_state}' invalid. Allowed: {sorted(VALID_TASK_STATES)}"
218            )
219        if self.schema != TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION:
220            raise TaskSpecValidationError(
221                f"schema '{self.schema}' invalid. Expected '{TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION}'"
222            )
223
224    def transition_to(self, new_state: str, reason: str = "") -> None:
225        """
226        Transitions the task to a new lifecycle state.
227        Raises InvalidStateTransitionError if the transition is illegal.
228        """
229        if new_state not in VALID_TASK_STATES:
230            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(f"Unknown target state: {new_state}")
231
232        allowed = STATE_TRANSITIONS.get(self.current_state, set())
233        if new_state not in allowed:
234            raise InvalidStateTransitionError(
235                f"Cannot transition task '{self.task_id}' from '{self.current_state}' to '{new_state}'. "
236                f"Allowed transitions from '{self.current_state}': {sorted(allowed)}"
237            )
238
239        self.current_state = new_state
240        if "history" not in self.metadata:
241            self.metadata["history"] = []
242        self.metadata["history"].append(
243            {"to_state": new_state, "reason": reason}
244        )
245

247        """Converts TaskSpec to dictionary representation."""
248        return asdict(self)

251    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> "TaskSpec":
252        """Constructs a TaskSpec from a dictionary."""
253        d = dict(data)
254        d.pop("schema", None)
255        valid_fields = {f.name for f in fields(cls)}
256        filtered = {k: v for k, v in d.items() if k in valid_fields}
257        return cls(schema=TASK_SPEC_SCHEMA_VERSION, **filtered)
258

260        """Serializes TaskSpec to formatted JSON string."""
261        return json.dumps(self.to_dict(), indent=indent)

265        """Deserializes TaskSpec from JSON string."""
266        data = json.loads(json_str)

def find_git_repo_root(start_dir: Union[str, pathlib.Path, NoneType] = None) -> pathlib.Path: 
118def find_git_repo_root(start_dir: Optional[Union[str, Path]] = None) -> Path:
119    """Discovers the root directory of the current Git repository using `git rev-parse`."""
120    target = Path(start_dir or os.getcwd()).resolve()
121    try:
122        res = run_git_in_repo(target, ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
123        if res.returncode == 0 and res.stdout.strip():
124            return Path(res.stdout.strip()).resolve()
125    except Exception:
126        pass
127
128    curr = target
129    while curr != curr.parent:
130        if (curr / ".git").exists():
131            return curr
132        curr = curr.parent
133
134    raise TargetRepositoryNotFoundError(
135        f"ERROR: no target Git repository found in '{target}'. HowlPlane must be run inside a Git repository."
136    )

Discovers the root directory of the current Git repository using git rev-parse.

def find_control_plane_root(override_path: Optional[str] = None) -> pathlib.Path: 
139def find_control_plane_root(override_path: Optional[str] = None) -> Path:
140    """Discovers the HowlPlane repository path using the 5-step precedence."""
141    if override_path:
142        p = Path(override_path).expanduser().resolve()
143        if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
144            return p
145        raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
146            f"ERROR: specified HowlPlane control plane path does not exist: {override_path}"
147        )
148
149    # 1. Primary canonical environment variable: HOWLPLANE_HOME / HOWLPLANE_DIR
150    env_path = os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_HOME") or os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_DIR")
151    if env_path:
152        p = Path(env_path).expanduser().resolve()
153        if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
154            return p
155        raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
156            f"ERROR: HOWLPLANE_HOME environment variable points to invalid path: {env_path}"
157        )
158
159    # 2. Deprecated legacy environment variable: AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY
160    legacy_env = os.environ.get("AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY")
161    if legacy_env:
162        p = Path(legacy_env).expanduser().resolve()
163        if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
164            print(
165                "WARNING: AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY environment variable is deprecated; please use HOWLPLANE_HOME instead.",
166                file=sys.stderr,
167            )
168            return p
169        raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
170            f"ERROR: legacy AI_KNOWLEDGE_LIBRARY environment variable points to invalid path: {legacy_env}"
171        )
172
173    # 3. Config file candidates (canonical ~/.config/howlplane/ followed by legacy fallbacks)
174    candidates = [
175        Path.home() / ".config" / "howlplane" / "config.toml",
176        Path.home() / ".config" / "ai-control-plane" / "config.toml",
177        Path.home() / ".config" / "ai" / "config.toml",
178    ]
179    for cfg in candidates:
180        if cfg.is_file():
181            try:
182                txt = cfg.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
183                match = re.search(r'path\s*=\s*["\']([^"\']+)["\']', txt)
184                if match:
185                    p = Path(match.group(1)).expanduser().resolve()
186                    if (p / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (p / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
187                        return p
188                    raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(f"ERROR: configured path in '{cfg}' is invalid: {match.group(1)}")
189            except ControlPlaneNotFoundError:
190                raise
191            except Exception:
192                pass
193
194    # 4. Self repository root detection
195    self_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
196    if ((self_root / "src" / "howlplane" / "control_plane").is_dir() or (self_root / "src" / "control_plane").is_dir()) and (self_root / "AGENTS.md").is_file():
197        return self_root
198
199    raise ControlPlaneNotFoundError(
200        "ERROR: configured HowlPlane control plane not found.\n"
201        "Please set the HOWLPLANE_HOME environment variable or configure ~/.config/howlplane/config.toml:\n\n"
202        "  [control_plane]\n"
203        "  path = \"/path/to/howlplane\"\n"
204    )

Discovers the HowlPlane repository path using the 5-step precedence.

def infer_task_metadata( objective: str, repo_name: str, explicit_id: Optional[str] = None, explicit_risk: Optional[str] = None, explicit_tier: Optional[str] = None, explicit_class: Optional[str] = None) -> Tuple[str, str, str, str]: 
225def infer_task_metadata(
226    objective: str,
227    repo_name: str,
228    explicit_id: Optional[str] = None,
229    explicit_risk: Optional[str] = None,
230    explicit_tier: Optional[str] = None,
231    explicit_class: Optional[str] = None,
232) -> Tuple[str, str, str, str]:
233    """Infers task ID, task class, risk level, and reasoning tier from objective text."""
234    clean_obj = objective.strip()
235    lowered = clean_obj.lower()
236
237    if explicit_id:
238        task_id = explicit_id
239    else:
240        issue_match = re.search(r'(?:issue|bug|item|task)\s*#?\s*([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)', clean_obj, re.IGNORECASE)
241        if issue_match:
242            issue_val = issue_match.group(1).upper()
243            if issue_val.startswith("TASK-") or issue_val.startswith("IMP-") or issue_val.startswith("ISSUE-"):
244                task_id = issue_val
245            else:
246                pfx = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', repo_name).upper()[:8] or "TASK"
247                task_id = f"{pfx}-{issue_val}"
248        else:
249            h_suf = hashlib.sha256(f"{repo_name}:{clean_obj}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:6].upper()
250            pfx = re.sub(r'[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', repo_name).upper()[:8] or "TASK"
251            task_id = f"{pfx}-{h_suf}"
252
253    if explicit_class:
254        task_class = explicit_class
255    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["security", "vuln", "auth", "cve", "patch", "exploit"]):
256        task_class = "security_patch"
257    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["fix", "bug", "crash", "error", "defect", "broken", "fail"]):
258        task_class = "bug_fix"
259    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["refactor", "clean", "simplify", "restructure"]):
260        task_class = "refactor"
261    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["test", "falsif", "mock", "assert", "coverage"]):
262        task_class = "test"
263    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["doc", "readme", "comment", "guide"]):
264        task_class = "documentation"
265    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["deploy", "infra", "terraform", "helm", "k8s", "docker"]):
266        task_class = "infrastructure"
267    else:
268        task_class = "feature"
269
270    if explicit_risk:
271        risk_level = explicit_risk
272    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["critical", "production", "deploy", "terraform apply", "drop table", "credential", "secret"]):
273        risk_level = "critical"
274    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["security", "vuln", "auth", "boundary", "migration", "k8s", "ingress", "infra"]):
275        risk_level = "high"
276    elif any(k in lowered for k in ["doc", "typo", "readme", "comment", "format", "style", "lint"]):
277        risk_level = "low"
278    else:
279        risk_level = "medium"
280
281    if explicit_tier:
282        reasoning_tier = explicit_tier
283    elif risk_level in ("high", "critical") or task_class in ("security_patch", "infrastructure"):
284        reasoning_tier = "tier_1"
285    elif risk_level == "low" and task_class == "documentation":
286        reasoning_tier = "tier_3"
287    else:
288        reasoning_tier = "tier_2"
289
290    return task_id, task_class, risk_level, reasoning_tier

Infers task ID, task class, risk level, and reasoning tier from objective text.

def format_agent_launch_command( agent_id: str, spec: howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec, run_dir: pathlib.Path, target_repo: pathlib.Path) -> str: 
293def format_agent_launch_command(agent_id: str, spec: TaskSpec, run_dir: Path, target_repo: Path) -> str:
294    """Generates the exact recommended agent launch command for the selected agent."""
295    t_path = run_dir / "task.yaml"
296    rel_p = str(t_path.relative_to(target_repo)) if t_path.is_relative_to(target_repo) else str(t_path)
297
298    if agent_id == "agy":
299        return f'agy -p "Task: {spec.task_id} - {spec.objective}. Review task spec at {rel_p} and execute." --mode accept-edits'
300    elif agent_id == "claude_code":
301        return f'claude "Execute governed task {spec.task_id}: {spec.objective} using control plane spec at {rel_p}"'
302    elif agent_id == "codex":
303        return f'codex "Execute task {spec.task_id}: {spec.objective} per {rel_p}"'
304    elif agent_id == "devin_cli":
305        return f'devin run --task-file {rel_p}'
306    elif agent_id == "local_ollama":
307        return f'ollama run qwen2.5-coder:32b "Task {spec.task_id}: {spec.objective}"'
308    return f'# Launch {agent_id} for task spec at {rel_p}'

Generates the exact recommended agent launch command for the selected agent.

def create_task_plan( ctx: howlplane.control_plane.project_adapter.ProjectContext, target_repo: pathlib.Path, cp_root: Optional[pathlib.Path], args: argparse.Namespace, resource_pool: Optional[howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool.ProviderPoolManager] = None) -> Tuple[howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec, howlplane.control_plane.router.RoutingDecision]: 
311def create_task_plan(
312    ctx: ProjectContext,
313    target_repo: Path,
314    cp_root: Optional[Path],
315    args: argparse.Namespace,
316    resource_pool: Optional[ProviderPoolManager] = None,
317) -> Tuple[TaskSpec, RoutingDecision]:
318    """Helper that constructs and routes a TaskSpec from CLI arguments."""
319    tid, tclass, risk, tier = infer_task_metadata(
320        objective=args.objective,
321        repo_name=ctx.name,
322        explicit_id=getattr(args, "task_id", None),
323        explicit_risk=getattr(args, "risk", None),
324        explicit_tier=getattr(args, "tier", None),
325        explicit_class=getattr(args, "task_class", None),
326    )
327    skills = list(dict.fromkeys(ctx.skills + (getattr(args, "skills", None) or ["software_development"])))
328    meta = {"target_repo_path": str(target_repo)}
329    if cp_root:
330        meta["control_plane_path"] = str(cp_root)
331
332    spec = TaskSpec(
333        task_id=tid,
334        repository=ctx.name,
335        objective=args.objective,
336        acceptance_criteria=getattr(args, "criteria", None) or [f"Complete objective: {args.objective}", "Pass deterministic verification suite"],
337        constraints=getattr(args, "constraints", None) or ["Adhere to project AGENTS.md and control plane policies"],
338        task_class=tclass,
339        risk_level=risk,
340        required_skills=skills,
341        recommended_reasoning_tier=tier,
342        preferred_agent=getattr(args, "agent", None),
343        metadata=meta,
344    )
345    decision = TaskRouter(resource_pool=resource_pool).route(spec)
346    return spec, decision

Helper that constructs and routes a TaskSpec from CLI arguments.

def cmd_work(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
530def cmd_work(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
531    """Executes the governed work command from any target repository."""
532    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
533    cp_root = find_control_plane_root(getattr(args, "control_plane_dir", None))
534
535    if not getattr(args, "skip_doctor", False):
536        from howlplane.control_plane.doctor import check_dependencies, check_git_status
537        dep_res = check_dependencies()
538        if dep_res.status == "error" and not getattr(args, "force", False):
539            print(f"ERROR: control-plane preflight failed: {dep_res.message}", file=sys.stderr)
540            return 1
541        git_res = check_git_status(target_repo)
542        if git_res.status == "error" and not getattr(args, "force", False):
543            print(f"ERROR: target repository preflight failed: {git_res.message}", file=sys.stderr)
544            return 1
545
546    ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
547    resource_pool = ProviderPoolManager.from_config()
548    spec, decision = create_task_plan(
549        ctx, target_repo, cp_root, args, resource_pool=resource_pool
550    )
551
552    planned_actions = getattr(args, "actions", None) or []
553    progress_mode = getattr(args, "progress", "auto")
554    if getattr(args, "quiet", False):
555        progress_mode = "never"
556
557    orchestrator = GovernedTaskOrchestrator(
558        target_repo=target_repo,
559        control_plane_root=cp_root,
560        config=OrchestrationConfig(
561            force=getattr(args, "force", False),
562            skip_doctor=getattr(args, "skip_doctor", False),
563            provider_pool=resource_pool,
564            progress_mode=progress_mode,
565        ),
566    )
567
568    if getattr(args, "execute", False):
569        res = orchestrator.run(spec, planned_actions=planned_actions)
570        _print_orchestration_summary(res, ctx, spec, decision)
571        return res.exit_code
572
573    # Dry run / task preparation mode (default when --execute is omitted)
574    ctx, decision, plan, run_dir, shadow_audit_res = orchestrator.prepare_task_plan(spec, planned_actions)
575    boundary_res = HumanBoundaryGate.evaluate(spec, planned_actions=planned_actions, verification=plan)
576    if not decision.selected_agent_id and not boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
577        print(json.dumps(decision.metadata["blocked_outcome"], indent=2))
578        return 3
579    launch_cmd = format_agent_launch_command(decision.selected_agent_id, spec, run_dir, target_repo)
580    df_mode = get_dogfood_mode()
581
582    print("=" * 60)
583    print("AI ENGINEERING CONTROL PLANE — TASK INITIALIZED")
584    print("=" * 60)
585    print(f"Target Repository:    {target_repo} ({ctx.name})")
586    print(f"Project Stack:        {', '.join(ctx.project_types) or 'generic'}")
587    print(f"Project AGENTS.md:    {'Present' if ctx.has_agents_md else 'Not found (using global policy)'}")
588    print(f"Hygiene Policy:       {ctx.hygiene_status}")
589    print(f"Task ID:              {spec.task_id}")
590    print(f"Objective:            {spec.objective}")
591    print(f"Risk Level:           {spec.risk_level.upper()}")
592    print(f"Reasoning Tier:       {decision.reasoning_tier}")
593    if decision.is_override:
594        print(f"Override Note:        {decision.override_reason}")
595    if df_mode == "shadow" and shadow_audit_res:
596        print("-" * 60)
597        print("HOWLFRAME SHADOW AUDIT (DOGFOODING):")
598        print(f"  Result:             {shadow_audit_res.audit_status or 'N/A'} ({shadow_audit_res.status}) [{shadow_audit_res.duration_seconds}s]")
599        if shadow_audit_res.findings:
600            print(f"  Findings:           {', '.join(shadow_audit_res.findings)}")
601        if shadow_audit_res.comparison_notes:
602            print(f"  Disagreements:      {', '.join(shadow_audit_res.comparison_notes)}")
603    print("-" * 60)
604    print("TASK ROUTING DECISION:")
605    print(f"Selected Agent:       {decision.selected_agent_name} (`{decision.selected_agent_id}`)")
606    print(f"Rationale:            {decision.rationale}")
607    print(f"Reviewer Roles:       {', '.join(decision.recommended_reviewers)}")
608    print("-" * 60)
609    print("DETERMINISTIC VERIFICATION PLAN:")
610    if plan.steps:
611        for idx, s in enumerate(plan.steps, 1):
612            print(f"  {idx}. [{s.category}] {s.name}")
613    else:
614        print("  (No automatic test/build steps discovered)")
615    print("-" * 60)
616    print("HUMAN AUTHORITY BOUNDARY:")
617    if boundary_res.requires_human_approval:
618        print("  🛑 AWAITING HUMAN APPROVAL (Boundary Triggered)")
619        for b in boundary_res.triggered_boundaries:
620            print(f"     - Boundary: {b}")
621        if boundary_res.decision_packet:
622            dp_path = run_dir / "decision_packet.md"
623            dp_path.write_text(boundary_res.decision_packet.render_markdown(), encoding="utf-8")
624            print(f"     - Decision packet written to: {dp_path}")
625    else:
626        print("  ✓ All actions within Autonomous Operating Authority")
627    print("-" * 60)
628    print("RUN ARTIFACTS PREPARED:")
629    print(f"Run Directory:        {run_dir}")
630    print(f"- Task Spec:          {run_dir / 'task.yaml'}")
631    print(f"- Review Briefs:      {run_dir / 'reviews'}/ ({len(decision.recommended_reviewers)} briefs)")
632    print(f"- Findings Template:  {run_dir / 'findings_template.yaml'}")
633    print(f"- Verification Plan:  {run_dir / 'verification_plan.json'}")
634    print("-" * 60)
635    print("RECOMMENDED AGENT LAUNCH COMMAND:")
636    print(f"  {launch_cmd}")
637    print("=" * 60)
638
639    return 2 if boundary_res.requires_human_approval else 0

Executes the governed work command from any target repository.

def cmd_route(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
642def cmd_route(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
643    """Lightweight read-only routing of an objective against the current target repository."""
644    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
645    ctx = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
646    pool = ProviderPoolManager.from_config(read_only=True, probe_on_start=False)
647    semantic_mode = getattr(args, "semantic", None)
648    if semantic_mode:
649        try:
650            pool.configure_semantic(
651                SemanticRecommendationSettings.model_validate(
652                    {**pool.semantic_settings.model_dump(), "mode": semantic_mode}
653                )
654            )
655        except ValueError as exc:
656            print(f"Error: invalid semantic recommendation settings: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
657            return 2
658    spec, _decision = create_task_plan(
659        ctx, target_repo, None, args, resource_pool=pool
660    )
661    selection = pool.select_resource(
662        spec,
663        role=getattr(args, "role", "implementation"),
664        explicit_resource_id=getattr(args, "agent", None),
665    )
666    if getattr(args, "json", False):
667        print(json.dumps(selection.to_dict(), indent=2))
668    else:
669        print(f"Target Repository: {target_repo} ({ctx.name})")
670        print(f"Objective: {spec.objective}\n")
671        print(render_route(selection))
672    return 0 if selection.selected else 3

Lightweight read-only routing of an objective against the current target repository.

def cmd_providers(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
675def cmd_providers(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
676    """Shows inventory or resets exactly one current capacity record."""
677    action = getattr(args, "provider_action", None)
678    resource_id = getattr(args, "resource_id", None)
679    if action == "reset":
680        if not resource_id:
681            print("ERROR: howlplane providers reset requires a resource ID", file=sys.stderr)
682            return 1
683        pool = ProviderPoolManager.from_config(probe_on_start=False)
684        state = pool.reset_resource(resource_id, reprobe=True)
685        try:
686            import howlplane.control_plane.launcher as _launcher
687            ledger_cls = getattr(_launcher, "EvidenceLedger", EvidenceLedger)
688        except Exception:
689            ledger_cls = EvidenceLedger
690        ledger_cls().append_entry(EvidenceEntry(
691            task_id="AI-RESOURCE-POOL",
692            agent_id="operator",
693            action="provider_capacity_reset",
694            result="reset",
695            metadata={
696                "resource_id": resource_id,
697                "capacity": state.status.value,
698                "readiness": state.readiness.value,
699            },
700        ))
701        print(json.dumps(state.to_dict(), indent=2) if getattr(args, "json", False) else (
702            f"Reset {resource_id}: readiness={state.readiness.value}; "
703            f"capacity={state.status.value}"
704        ))
705        return 0
706    pool = ProviderPoolManager.from_config(read_only=True, probe_on_start=True)
707    print(
708        json.dumps(inventory_document(pool), indent=2)
709        if getattr(args, "json", False) else render_inventory(pool)
710    )
711    return 0

Shows inventory or resets exactly one current capacity record.

def cmd_status(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
 19def cmd_status(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
 20    """Displays project status, active task runs, lock status, and crash recovery diagnostics."""
 21    target_repo = _cli()._resolve_repo(args)
 22    cp_root = _cli().find_control_plane_root(getattr(args, "control_plane_dir", None))
 23    ctx = _cli().ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
 24
 25    print("=" * 60)
 26    print(f"AI CONTROL PLANE — PROJECT STATUS: {ctx.name}")
 27    print("=" * 60)
 28    print(f"Repository Path:    {target_repo}")
 29    print(f"Control Plane:      {cp_root}")
 30    print(f"Project Stack:      {', '.join(ctx.project_types) or 'generic'}")
 31    print(f"Project AGENTS.md:  {'Present' if ctx.has_agents_md else 'Not found'}")
 32    print(f"Hygiene Status:     {ctx.hygiene_status}")
 33
 34    # Inspect Repository Lock
 35    repo_lock_file = _cli().get_repo_lock_path(target_repo)
 36    if repo_lock_file.exists():
 37        try:
 38            l_data = json.loads(repo_lock_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 39            alive, _ = _cli().is_process_alive(l_data.get("pid", 0), l_data.get("hostname", ""))
 40            status_str = "ACTIVE" if alive else "STALE (Reclaimable)"
 41            print(f"Repository Lock:    {status_str} — Task: {l_data.get('task_id')}, PID: {l_data.get('pid')}, Command: '{l_data.get('command')}'")
 42        except Exception:
 43            print("Repository Lock:    Present (Unparseable)")
 44    else:
 45        print("Repository Lock:    Unlocked (Available)")
 46
 47    print("-" * 60)
 48    print("VERIFICATION COMMANDS DISCOVERED:")
 49    plan = _cli().ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(ctx, task_id="STATUS-CHECK")
 50    if plan.steps:
 51        for idx, s in enumerate(plan.steps, 1):
 52            cmd_display = ' '.join(s.command) if isinstance(s.command, list) else s.command
 53            print(f"  {idx}. [{s.category}] {cmd_display}")
 54    else:
 55        print("  (No automatic test/build commands detected)")
 56
 57    df_mode = _cli().get_dogfood_mode()
 58    h_bin = _cli().find_howlframe_binary()
 59    h_ver = _cli().get_howlframe_version(h_bin) if h_bin else None
 60    print("-" * 60)
 61    print("HOWLFRAME DOGFOOD STATUS:")
 62    print(f"  Mode:               {df_mode}")
 63    if h_bin:
 64        print(f"  Binary:             {h_bin} ({h_ver or '0.1.0'})")
 65        if df_mode == "shadow":
 66            audit_res = _cli().HowlFrameAuditRunner.run_audit(ctx, record_evidence=False, dogfood_mode="shadow")
 67            print(f"  Audit Result:       {audit_res.audit_status or 'N/A'} ({audit_res.status}) [{audit_res.duration_seconds}s]")
 68            if audit_res.findings:
 69                print(f"  Findings:           {', '.join(audit_res.findings)}")
 70            if audit_res.comparison_notes:
 71                print(f"  Disagreements:      {', '.join(audit_res.comparison_notes)}")
 72    else:
 73        print("  Binary:             Not available (PATH)")
 74
 75    task_runs_dir = target_repo / ".task_runs"
 76    runs = []
 77    if task_runs_dir.is_dir():
 78        runs = [d.name for d in task_runs_dir.iterdir() if d.is_dir() and (d / "task.yaml").exists()]
 79
 80    print("-" * 60)
 81    print(f"ACTIVE TASK RUNS ({len(runs)}):")
 82    if runs:
 83        for r in sorted(runs):
 84            t_dir = task_runs_dir / r
 85            t_file = t_dir / "task.yaml"
 86            try:
 87                rec_diag = _cli().CrashRecoveryEngine.inspect_task(target_repo, r)
 88                t_spec = _cli().TaskSpec.load_from_file(str(t_file))
 89                rec_file = t_dir / "reconciliation.json"
 90                blockers = 0
 91                highs = 0
 92                if rec_file.exists():
 93                    try:
 94                        rec_data = json.loads(rec_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
 95                        blockers = rec_data.get("summary", {}).get("unresolved_blockers", 0)
 96                        highs = rec_data.get("summary", {}).get("unresolved_highs", 0)
 97                    except Exception:
 98                        pass
 99                ver_file = t_dir / "verification_result.json"
100                ver_status = "unverified"
101                if ver_file.exists():
102                    try:
103                        ver_data = json.loads(ver_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
104                        ver_status = ver_data.get("overall_status", "unverified")
105                    except Exception:
106                        pass
107
108                dp_file = t_dir / "decision_packet.md"
109                dp_rel = (
110                    str(dp_file.relative_to(target_repo))
111                    if dp_file.is_file() and dp_file.is_relative_to(target_repo)
112                    else str(dp_file)
113                )
114
115                prog_file = t_dir / "progress.json"
116                prog_data = None
117                if prog_file.is_file():
118                    try:
119                        prog_data = _cli().safe_load_json(prog_file)
120                    except Exception:
121                        prog_data = None
122
123                if t_spec.current_state == "awaiting_human":
124                    dec_record = _cli().HumanLifecycleManager.load_decision(t_dir)
125                    current_fp = _cli().compute_repository_fingerprint(target_repo, t_dir)
126                    boundaries_list = t_spec.human_approval_requirements or ["human_authority_boundary"]
127                    boundaries_str = ", ".join(boundaries_list)
128                    receipt_file = t_dir / "execution_receipt.json"
129
130                    print(f"  Task:               {t_spec.task_id}")
131                    print(f"  State:              AWAITING_HUMAN (Stage: {rec_diag.get('last_stage', 'awaiting_human')})")
132                    print(f"  Verification:       {ver_status.upper()}")
133                    if dec_record and dec_record.changeops_decision_id:
134                        print(f"  ChangeOps Decision: {dec_record.changeops_decision_id}")
135                    if receipt_file.is_file():
136                        try:
137                            rc_data = json.loads(receipt_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
138                            print(f"  Execution Receipt:  {rc_data.get('status', 'unknown').upper()} (Verification: {rc_data.get('verification_status', 'PASS')})")
139                        except Exception:
140                            pass
141                    elif rec_diag.get("native_receipt_found"):
142                        print("  Execution Receipt:  PENDING_RECONCILIATION (Found in HowlChangeOps native receipts)")
143
144                    if not dec_record:
145                        print(f"  Repository State:   CURRENT")
146                        print(f"  Boundary:           {boundaries_str}")
147                        print(f"  Decision:           pending")
148                        if dp_file.is_file():
149                            print(f"  Decision Packet:    {dp_rel}")
150                        print("")
151                        print("  Next Action:")
152                        print(f"    howlplane approve {t_spec.task_id}")
153                        print(f"    howlplane reject {t_spec.task_id}")
154                    elif dec_record.decision == "approved":
155                        has_drift, drift_reason = (
156                            _cli().check_repository_drift(dec_record.repository_state, current_fp)
157                            if dec_record.repository_state
158                            else (False, None)
159                        )
160                        appr_state = f"STALE ({drift_reason})" if has_drift else "CURRENT"
161                        print(f"  Boundary:           {boundaries_str}")
162                        print(f"  Decision:           APPROVED")
163                        print(f"  Approval State:     {appr_state}")
164                        if dp_file.is_file():
165                            print(f"  Decision Packet:    {dp_rel}")
166                        print("")
167                        print("  Next Action:")
168                        if has_drift:
169                            print(f"    howlplane approve {t_spec.task_id} --reason \"re-approved after drift\"")
170                        else:
171                            print(f"    howlplane resume {t_spec.task_id}")
172                    elif dec_record.decision == "rejected":
173                        print(f"  Decision:           REJECTED")
174                        if dec_record.reason:
175                            print(f"  Reason:             {dec_record.reason}")
176                        print("  Terminal state:     FAILED (Rejected)")
177                    print("-" * 40)
178                elif (
179                    prog_data
180                    and prog_data.get("state") == "RUNNING"
181                    and t_spec.current_state not in _cli().TERMINAL_TASK_STATES
182                ):
183                    p_phase = prog_data.get("phase", t_spec.current_state.upper())
184                    p_resource = prog_data.get("resource_id") or t_spec.actual_agent or t_spec.recommended_agent or "N/A"
185                    p_elapsed = _cli().format_elapsed(prog_data.get("elapsed_seconds", 0))
186                    p_heartbeat = _cli().format_last_heartbeat(prog_data.get("updated_at"))
187                    p_pid = prog_data.get("pid")
188
189                    is_proc_alive = False
190                    if rec_diag.get("is_process_running"):
191                        is_proc_alive = True
192                    elif p_pid:
193                        import socket
194                        from howlplane.control_plane.locking import is_process_alive as check_pid_alive
195                        is_proc_alive, _ = check_pid_alive(p_pid, socket.gethostname())
196
197                    state_label = "RUNNING" if is_proc_alive else "STALE (Process not running)"
198
199                    print(f"  {t_spec.task_id}")
200                    print(f"    State:          {state_label}")
201                    print(f"    Phase:          {p_phase}")
202                    print(f"    Resource:       {p_resource}")
203                    print(f"    Elapsed:        {p_elapsed}")
204                    print(f"    Last heartbeat: {p_heartbeat}")
205                    c_revs = rec_diag.get("completed_reviewers", [])
206                    if c_revs:
207                        print(f"    Completed Reviews: {', '.join(c_revs)}")
208                    for role, disposition in (rec_diag.get("reviewer_dispositions") or {}).items():
209                        if disposition not in ("completed_clean", "completed_with_findings"):
210                            print(f"      - {role}: {disposition.upper()}")
211                    if not is_proc_alive:
212                        rec_action = rec_diag.get('recommendation') or f"howlplane resume {t_spec.task_id}"
213                        print(f"    Recommendation:    {rec_action}")
214                    print("-" * 40)
215                elif t_spec.current_state in ("interrupted", "cancelled", "implementing", "reviewing", "remediating", "verifying"):
216                    print(f"  Task:               {t_spec.task_id}")
217                    print(f"  State:              {t_spec.current_state.upper()} (Last Stage: {rec_diag.get('last_stage')})")
218                    print(f"  Classification:     {rec_diag.get('classification', 'RECONCILE_FIRST')}")
219                    if rec_diag.get("is_process_running"):
220                        p_info = rec_diag.get("process_info") or {}
221                        print(f"  Process:            RUNNING (PID: {p_info.get('pid')}, Backend: {p_info.get('backend')})")
222                    if rec_diag.get("completed_reviewers"):
223                        print(f"  Completed Reviews:  {', '.join(rec_diag.get('completed_reviewers'))}")
224                    if rec_diag.get("incomplete_reviewers"):
225                        print(f"  Pending Reviews:    {', '.join(rec_diag.get('incomplete_reviewers'))}")
226                    for role, disposition in (rec_diag.get("reviewer_dispositions") or {}).items():
227                        if disposition not in ("completed_clean", "completed_with_findings"):
228                            print(f"    - {role}: {disposition.upper()}")
229                    print(f"  Recommendation:     {rec_diag.get('recommendation')}")
230                    print("-" * 40)
231                else:
232                    print(f"  - {r}: [{t_spec.current_state.upper()}] {t_spec.objective} (Risk: {t_spec.risk_level.upper()}, Agent: {t_spec.actual_agent or t_spec.recommended_agent or 'N/A'}, Blockers: {blockers}, Highs: {highs}, Verification: {ver_status})")
233            except Exception:
234                print(f"  - {r}")
235    else:
236        print("  (No task runs in .task_runs/)")
237
238    journal_dir = target_repo / "documentation" / "task_journals"
239    journals = []
240    if journal_dir.is_dir():
241        journals = [f.name for f in journal_dir.glob("*.md") if f.name != "TEMPLATE.md"]
242
243    if journals:
244        print("-" * 60)
245        print(f"TASK JOURNALS ({len(journals)}):")
246        for j in sorted(journals):
247            print(f"  - {j}")
248
249    print("=" * 60)
250    return 0
