def cmd_prepare_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
770def cmd_prepare_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
771    """Prepares structured task run directory and reviewer briefs for cross-agent handoffs."""
772    spec = TaskSpec.load_from_file(args.task_file)
773    diff_text = Path(args.diff_file).read_text(encoding="utf-8") if args.diff_file else ""
774
775    run_dir = Path(args.run_dir or f".task_runs/{spec.task_id}")
776    reviews_dir = run_dir / "reviews"
777    reviews_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
778
779    # Save copy of task spec and diff
780    spec.save_to_file(str(run_dir / "task.yaml"))
781    if diff_text:
782        (run_dir / "diff.patch").write_text(diff_text, encoding="utf-8")
783
784    router = TaskRouter()
785    decision = router.route(spec)
786    reviewers_to_run = args.roles or decision.recommended_reviewers
787
788    print(f"Preparing dogfood task run in {run_dir}/...")
789    print(f"- Implementation Agent: {decision.selected_agent_name} (`{decision.selected_agent_id}`)")
790    print(f"- Generating {len(reviewers_to_run)} independent reviewer briefs in {reviews_dir}/:")
791
792    for role_id in reviewers_to_run:
793        role = get_reviewer_role(role_id)
794        if not role:
795            continue
796        brief = role.render_brief(task=spec, diff_content=diff_text)
797        brief_file = reviews_dir / f"{role_id}.md"
798        brief_file.write_text(brief, encoding="utf-8")
799        print(f"   ✓ {brief_file.name}")
800
801    # Write findings template
802    template_file = run_dir / "findings_template.yaml"
803    template_content = """# Review Findings Template
804# Collect structured findings from independent reviewer roles below.
805findings:
806  # Example:
807  # - id: "F001"
808  #   reviewer_role: "test-falsifier"
809  #   title: "Missing negative test case for edge input"
810  #   severity: "high"
811  #   category: "test_gap"
812  #   location: "tests/test_feature.py:45"
813  #   description: "Test does not check None input handling."
814  #   evidence: "Calling feature(None) raises unhandled exception."
815  #   suggested_fix: "Add test_feature_handles_none_gracefully."
816"""
817    template_file.write_text(template_content, encoding="utf-8")
818    print(f"- Template written: {template_file}")
819    print(f"\nTask run initialized successfully at {run_dir}.")
820    return 0

Prepares structured task run directory and reviewer briefs for cross-agent handoffs.

def cmd_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
848def cmd_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
849    """Executes a verification plan for a project or task."""
850    target_repo = _resolve_repo(args)
851    context = ProjectAdapter.discover(target_repo)
852    task_id = getattr(args, "task_id", None) or "VERIFY-RUN"
853
854    plan = ProjectAdapter.create_verification_plan(context, task_id=task_id)
855    print(f"Running verification plan for project '{context.name}' ({len(plan.steps)} steps)...")
856    status = plan.execute_all(cwd=str(target_repo))
857
858    for step in plan.steps:
859        mark = "✓" if step.status == "verified" else "✗"
860        interp_info = f" [using {step.interpreter}]" if step.interpreter else ""
861        print(f"[{mark}] {step.name}: {step.status} (exit {step.exit_code}, {step.duration_seconds}s){interp_info}")
862        if step.status == "failed" and step.stderr:
863            print(f"    Error: {step.stderr.strip()[:200]}")
864
865    print(f"\nOverall Verification Status: {status.upper()}")
866
867    out_file = args.output
868    if not out_file and args.run_dir:
869        out_file = str(Path(args.run_dir) / "verification.json")
870
871    if out_file:
872        Path(out_file).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
873        Path(out_file).write_text(plan.to_json(), encoding="utf-8")
874        print(f"Saved verification output to {out_file}")
875
876    return 0 if status == "passed" else 1

Executes a verification plan for a project or task.

def cmd_unlock(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
205def cmd_unlock(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
206    """Reclaims the locks holding a task back, when their owners are gone.
207
208    The one explicit, audited takeover path. `ai resume` deliberately keeps its
209    fail-closed behavior, so nothing ever steals a lock implicitly; a person
210    asks for this, and the reclamation is recorded (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05).
211    Both the task-run lock and the repository lock are inspected, so what this
212    command acts on matches what `ai status` reports (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).
213    """
214    from howlplane.control_plane.locking import (
215        LockError,
216        classify_lock_owner,
217        reclaim_lock,
218    )
219    from howlplane.control_plane.atomic_io import safe_load_json
220
221    target_repo = str(_cli()._resolve_repo(args))
222    ledger_file = _cli()._resolve_ledger_file(args)
223    ledger = _cli().EvidenceLedger(ledger_file) if ledger_file else None
224    as_json = bool(getattr(args, "json", False))
225
226    def audit(action, result, artifact=None, metadata=None):
227        if ledger is None:
228            return
229        ledger.append_entry(
230            _cli().EvidenceEntry(
231                task_id=args.task_id,
232                agent_id="human_operator",
233                action=action,
234                command=f"ai unlock {args.task_id}",
235                result=result,
236                artifact=artifact,
237                repository=str(target_repo),
238                metadata=metadata or {},
239            )
240        )
241
242    audit("unlock_requested", "REQUESTED")
243
244    inspected = []
245    reclaimed = []
246    refusals = []
247
248    for label, lock_path in _cli()._lock_candidates(target_repo, args.task_id):
249        if not lock_path.exists():
250            continue
251        try:
252            owner = safe_load_json(lock_path)
253        except Exception as err:
254            refusals.append(f"{label} lock at '{lock_path}' is unreadable: {err}")
255            continue
256
257        relevant, why_not = _cli()._lock_relevance(owner, args.task_id)
258        state, reason = classify_lock_owner(
259            owner.get("pid", -1),
260            owner.get("hostname", ""),
261            owner.get("process_create_time", 0.0),
262        )
263        inspected.append(
264            {
265                "scope": label,
266                "path": str(lock_path),
267                "owner_state": state.value,
268                "reason": reason,
269                "relevant": relevant,
270                "pid": owner.get("pid"),
271                "hostname": owner.get("hostname"),
272                "operation": owner.get("operation"),
273                "task_id": owner.get("task_id"),
274            }
275        )
276
277        if not as_json:
278            print(f"{label.capitalize()} lock: {lock_path}")
279            print(
280                f"  Owner: pid {owner.get('pid')} @ {owner.get('hostname')} "
281                f"({owner.get('command')}) -- {state.value}"
282            )
283            print(f"  {reason}")
284
285        if not relevant:
286            msg = f"Refusing to reclaim {label} lock: {why_not}."
287            refusals.append(msg)
288            if not as_json:
289                print(f"  {msg}")
290            audit(
291                "unlock_refused",
292                "NOT_THIS_TASK",
293                artifact=str(lock_path),
294                metadata={"scope": label, "reason": why_not},
295            )
296            continue
297
298        try:
299            record = reclaim_lock(lock_path)
300        except LockError as err:
301            refusals.append(str(err))
302            if not as_json:
303                print(f"  ERROR: {err}")
304            audit(
305                "unlock_refused",
306                state.value,
307                artifact=str(lock_path),
308                metadata={"scope": label, "reason": str(err)},
309            )
310            continue
311
312        payload = record.to_dict()
313        payload["scope"] = label
314        reclaimed.append(payload)
315        # Keeps the established ledger vocabulary rather than introducing a
316        # second name for the same event.
317        audit(
318            "stale_lock_reclaimed",
319            record.owner_state,
320            artifact=record.lock_path,
321            metadata=payload,
322        )
323        if not as_json:
324            print(f"  Reclaimed {record.owner_state} {label} lock.")
325
326    if as_json:
327        import json
328        print(
329            json.dumps(
330                {
331                    "task_id": args.task_id,
332                    "inspected": inspected,
333                    "reclaimed": reclaimed,
334                    "refused": refusals,
335                },
336                indent=2,
337            )
338        )
339
340    if not inspected:
341        if not as_json:
342            print(f"No locks held for '{args.task_id}'. Nothing to reclaim.")
343        audit("unlock_requested", "NO_OP")
344        return 0
345
346    if reclaimed:
347        if not as_json:
348            print(f"You can now run: howlplane resume {args.task_id}")
349        return 0
350
351    return 1 if refusals else 0

Reclaims the locks holding a task back, when their owners are gone.

The one explicit, audited takeover path. ai resume deliberately keeps its fail-closed behavior, so nothing ever steals a lock implicitly; a person asks for this, and the reclamation is recorded (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-05). Both the task-run lock and the repository lock are inspected, so what this command acts on matches what ai status reports (HOWLFRAM-SLOPFIX-06).

def cmd_acceptance(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
2300def cmd_acceptance(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
2301    """
2302    Live governed-integration acceptance canary (#59.2 Phases 15-18).
2303    `ai acceptance overnight-integration` runs exactly one bounded governed
2304    engineering task -- through the real GovernedTaskOrchestrator, real
2305    independent review, real deterministic verification, and real
2306    GitIntegrationExecutor branch/commit/push/PR/CI/merge/remote-verify/
2307    local-sync lifecycle -- to prove that lifecycle end-to-end with no
2308    mocked git/gh boundary. The task is mechanically scoped to touch only
2309    its designated evidence artifact under documentation/task_journals/.
2310    """
2311    if getattr(args, "acceptance_action", None) != "overnight-integration":
2312        print("Usage: howlplane acceptance overnight-integration --authority-profile <strict|overnight-safe>")
2313        return 1
2314
2315    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis import MarathonDogfoodEngine
2316    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool import ProviderPoolManager
2317
2318    ledger = EvidenceLedger(args.ledger_file) if getattr(args, "ledger_file", None) else None
2319    engine = MarathonDogfoodEngine(
2320        provider_pool=ProviderPoolManager.from_config(),
2321        campaign_dir=getattr(args, "campaign_dir", None),
2322        target_repo=getattr(args, "target_repo", None) or ".",
2323        repo_slug=getattr(args, "repo_slug", None),
2324        ledger=ledger,
2325    )
2326    result = engine.run_acceptance_canary(authority_profile_id=args.authority_profile)
2327    git_rec = result.get("git_record") or {}
2328    fully_verified = bool(
2329        git_rec.get("merged") and git_rec.get("remote_main_contains_merge") and git_rec.get("local_main_synced")
2330    )
2331
2332    if getattr(args, "json", False):
2333        import json
2334        print(json.dumps({**result, "fully_verified": fully_verified}, indent=2))
2335    else:
2336        print("=" * 60)
2337        print(f"HOWLPLANE — LIVE ACCEPTANCE CANARY: {result['campaign_id']}")
2338        print("=" * 60)
2339        print(f"Task ID:            {result['task_id']}")
2340        print(f"Journal path:       {result['journal_path']}")
2341        print(f"Task success:       {result['task_success']}")
2342        print(f"Branch:             {git_rec.get('branch')}")
2343        print(f"Commit SHA:         {git_rec.get('commit_sha')}")
2344        print(f"PR:                 #{git_rec.get('pr_number')} {git_rec.get('pr_url') or ''}")
2345        print(f"CI status:          {git_rec.get('ci_status')}")
2346        print(f"Merged:             {git_rec.get('merged')}")
2347        print(f"Merge SHA:          {git_rec.get('merge_sha')}")
2348        print(f"Remote verified:    {git_rec.get('remote_main_contains_merge')}")
2349        print(f"Local synced:       {git_rec.get('local_main_synced')}")
2350        if git_rec.get("failure_reason"):
2351            print(f"Failure reason:     {git_rec.get('failure_reason')}")
2352        print(f"Fully verified:     {fully_verified}")
2353        print("=" * 60)
2354
2355    return 0 if fully_verified else 1

Live governed-integration acceptance canary (#59.2 Phases 15-18). ai acceptance overnight-integration runs exactly one bounded governed engineering task -- through the real GovernedTaskOrchestrator, real independent review, real deterministic verification, and real GitIntegrationExecutor branch/commit/push/PR/CI/merge/remote-verify/ local-sync lifecycle -- to prove that lifecycle end-to-end with no mocked git/gh boundary. The task is mechanically scoped to touch only its designated evidence artifact under documentation/task_journals/.

def cmd_marathon(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
1925def cmd_marathon(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
1926    """Works a bounded sequence of the target repository's ranked backlog."""
1927    import json as _json
1928    import sys as _sys
1929    from howlplane.control_plane.backlog_source import BacklogSource
1930    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis import MarathonDogfoodEngine
1931    from howlplane.control_plane.synthesis.provider_pool import ProviderPoolManager
1932
1933    target_repo = getattr(args, "target_repo", None) or "."
1934
1935    if getattr(args, "dry_run", False):
1936        # Read-only: shows exactly which items are eligible and why the
1937        # near-misses are not, without binding an authority envelope or
1938        # invoking any provider.
1939        selection = BacklogSource(
1940            target_repo, roi_floor=getattr(args, "roi_floor", 0.5)
1941        ).select()
1942        payload = {
1943            "target_repo": target_repo,
1944            "files_read": selection.files_read,
1945            "eligible": [item.to_dict() for item in selection.eligible],
1946            "excluded": selection.excluded,
1947            "would_work": [
1948                item.task_id for item in selection.eligible[: args.max_tasks]
1949            ],
1950        }
1951        if getattr(args, "json", False):
1952            print(_json.dumps(payload, indent=2))
1953        else:
1954            print("=" * 60)
1955            print(f"HOWLPLANE — MARATHON DRY RUN: {target_repo}")
1956            print("=" * 60)
1957            print(f"Backlogs read:      {', '.join(selection.files_read) or 'none'}")
1958            print(f"Eligible items:     {len(selection.eligible)}")
1959            print(f"Would work (max {args.max_tasks}):")
1960            for item in selection.eligible[: args.max_tasks]:
1961                print(f"  - {item.task_id}  score={item.score}  {item.title}")
1962            if selection.excluded:
1963                print("\nPending but NOT eligible:")
1964                for excluded in selection.excluded:
1965                    print(f"  - #{excluded['item_id']} ({excluded['source_file']}): {excluded['reason']}")
1966            print("\nNo provider was invoked and nothing was written.")
1967        return 0
1968
1969    ledger = EvidenceLedger(args.ledger_file) if getattr(args, "ledger_file", None) else None
1970    engine = MarathonDogfoodEngine(
1971        provider_pool=ProviderPoolManager.from_config(),
1972        ledger=ledger,
1973        campaign_dir=getattr(args, "campaign_dir", None),
1974        target_repo=target_repo,
1975        repo_slug=getattr(args, "repo_slug", None),
1976    )
1977    report = engine.run_backlog_marathon(
1978        authority_profile_id=args.authority_profile,
1979        max_tasks=args.max_tasks,
1980        max_runtime_hours=args.max_runtime_hours,
1981        resume_campaign_id=getattr(args, "resume", None),
1982        roi_floor=getattr(args, "roi_floor", 0.5),
1983    )
1984
1985    if report.get("refused"):
1986        # Fail-closed preflight: the campaign never started. Reported on stderr
1987        # with a non-zero exit so an unattended wrapper cannot read it as a run
1988        # that simply found nothing to do.
1989        if getattr(args, "json", False):
1990            print(_json.dumps(report, indent=2))
1991        else:
1992            print("=" * 60, file=_sys.stderr)
1993            print("HOWLPLANE — MARATHON REFUSED", file=_sys.stderr)
1994            print("=" * 60, file=_sys.stderr)
1995            print(report["refusal_reason"], file=_sys.stderr)
1996            print("\nWorking tree changes found:", file=_sys.stderr)
1997            for path in report["dirty_files"]:
1998                print(f"  {path}", file=_sys.stderr)
1999        return 2
2000
2001    if getattr(args, "json", False):
2002        print(_json.dumps(report, indent=2))
2003    else:
2004        print("=" * 60)
2005        print(f"HOWLPLANE — BACKLOG MARATHON: {report['campaign_id']}")
2006        print("=" * 60)
2007        print(f"Repository:     {report['target_repo']} ({report['repo_slug'] or 'no slug'})")
2008        print(f"Authority:      {report['authority_profile']}")
2009        print(f"Stop reason:    {report['stop_reason']}")
2010        print(f"Attempted:      {', '.join(report['tasks_attempted']) or 'none'}")
2011        print(f"Completed:      {', '.join(report['tasks_completed']) or 'none'}")
2012        print(f"Failed:         {', '.join(report['tasks_failed']) or 'none'}")
2013        print(f"Parked:         {', '.join(report['tasks_parked']) or 'none'}")
2014        print(f"Duration:       {report['duration_seconds']}s")
2015        print(f"State:          {report['state_dir']}")
2016    # A parked task is not a failure: it is the control plane correctly
2017    # refusing to exceed its delegated authority, and the operator decides.
2018    return 0 if not report["tasks_failed"] else 1

Works a bounded sequence of the target repository's ranked backlog.

def cmd_local(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
2399def cmd_local(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
2400    """
2401    Local (Ollama) model utilities (#58 Phase 3). `ai local setup`:
2402      1. checks whether Ollama is installed
2403      2. installs it via the official installer if missing and the operator
2404         confirms (or if HOWLPLANE_LOCAL_AUTO_INSTALL=1 is set)
2405      3. pulls the canonical model
2406      4. verifies with `ollama list`
2407      5. performs a tiny real inference ("Respond only with LOCAL_OK")
2408      6. reports PASS/FAIL with duration and observed details
2409
2410    Never pulls any model other than the one requested (default:
2411    qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct), and never installs anything beyond the
2412    official Ollama runtime.
2413    """
2414    import shutil as _shutil
2415    import subprocess as _subprocess
2416    import time as _time
2417
2418    from howlplane.control_plane.agent_execution import OllamaLocalBackend, diagnose_ollama
2419    from howlplane.control_plane.task_spec import TaskSpec
2420
2421    model = getattr(args, "model", "qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct")
2422    report: Dict[str, Any] = {"model": model, "steps": []}
2423
2424    def _step(name: str, ok: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
2425        report["steps"].append({"name": name, "ok": ok, "detail": detail})
2426        symbol = "OK" if ok else "FAIL"
2427        print(f"[{symbol}] {name}{': ' + detail if detail else ''}")
2428
2429    if not _shutil.which("ollama"):
2430        auto_install = os.environ.get("HOWLPLANE_LOCAL_AUTO_INSTALL") == "1"
2431        if not auto_install:
2432            _step(
2433                "ollama_installed", False,
2434                "Ollama is not installed. Re-run with HOWLPLANE_LOCAL_AUTO_INSTALL=1 to "
2435                "install it via the official installer (curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh), "
2436                "or install it yourself first.",
2437            )
2438            report["result"] = "FAIL"
2439            _print_local_report(args, report)
2440            return 1
2441        try:
2442            _subprocess.run(  # nosec B602 - fixed official install command, no shell interpolation of user input
2443                ["bash", "-c", "curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh"],
2444                check=True, timeout=600,
2445            )
2446            _step("ollama_installed", True, "Installed via official installer")
2447        except Exception as exc:
2448            _step("ollama_installed", False, f"Install failed: {exc}")
2449            report["result"] = "FAIL"
2450            _print_local_report(args, report)
2451            return 1
2452    else:
2453        _step("ollama_installed", True, "Already on PATH")
2454
2455    diag = diagnose_ollama(model=model)
2456    if diag.reason == "OLLAMA_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE":
2457        _step("ollama_service", False, diag.detail)
2458        report["result"] = "FAIL"
2459        _print_local_report(args, report)
2460        return 1
2461    _step("ollama_service", diag.reason != "OLLAMA_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE", diag.detail)
2462
2463    if diag.reason == "MODEL_NOT_INSTALLED":
2464        try:
2465            _subprocess.run(["ollama", "pull", model], check=True, timeout=3600)
2466            _step("model_pulled", True, f"Pulled {model}")
2467        except Exception as exc:
2468            _step("model_pulled", False, str(exc))
2469            report["result"] = "FAIL"
2470            _print_local_report(args, report)
2471            return 1
2472    else:
2473        _step("model_pulled", True, "Already installed")
2474
2475    try:
2476        listing = _subprocess.run(["ollama", "list"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
2477        model_listed = model.split(":")[0] in listing.stdout
2478        _step("ollama_list", model_listed, listing.stdout.strip().splitlines()[-1] if listing.stdout.strip() else "")
2479    except Exception as exc:
2480        _step("ollama_list", False, str(exc))
2481
2482    backend = OllamaLocalBackend(model=model)
2483    probe_task = TaskSpec(task_id="LOCAL-SETUP-PROBE", repository="howlplane", objective="local setup smoke test", risk_level="low", task_class="docs")
2484    t0 = _time.time()
2485    result = backend.execute(probe_task, cwd=".", prompt_override="Respond only with LOCAL_OK", timeout_seconds=120)
2486    elapsed = round(_time.time() - t0, 3)
2487    inference_ok = result.success and "LOCAL_OK" in result.stdout
2488    _step("inference_smoke_test", inference_ok, f"stdout={result.stdout.strip()!r} duration={elapsed}s")
2489
2490    report["result"] = "PASS" if inference_ok else "FAIL"
2491    report["duration_seconds"] = elapsed
2492    _print_local_report(args, report)
2493    return 0 if inference_ok else 1

Local (Ollama) model utilities (#58 Phase 3). ai local setup:

  1. checks whether Ollama is installed
  2. installs it via the official installer if missing and the operator confirms (or if HOWLPLANE_LOCAL_AUTO_INSTALL=1 is set)
  3. pulls the canonical model
  4. verifies with ollama list
  5. performs a tiny real inference ("Respond only with LOCAL_OK")
  6. reports PASS/FAIL with duration and observed details

Never pulls any model other than the one requested (default: qwen2.5-coder:7b-instruct), and never installs anything beyond the official Ollama runtime.

def cmd_factory(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
490def cmd_factory(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
491    try:
492        action = getattr(args, "factory_action", None)
493        if action == "run-once":
494            return _cli().cmd_factory_run_once(args)
495        if action == "run":
496            return _cli().cmd_factory_run(args)
497        if action == "status":
498            return _cli().cmd_factory_status(args)
499        if action == "pending":
500            from howlplane.control_plane.factory import remote_cli
501            return remote_cli.cmd_factory_pending(args)
502        if action == "snapshot":
503            from howlplane.control_plane.factory import remote_cli
504            return remote_cli.cmd_factory_snapshot(args)
505        if action == "stop":
506            return _cli().cmd_factory_stop(args)
507        if action == "resume":
508            return _cli().cmd_factory_resume(args)
509        if action == "start":
510            return _cli().cmd_factory_start(args)
511        if action == "logs":
512            return _cli().cmd_factory_logs(args)
513        if action == "prepare":
514            from howlplane.control_plane.factory import prepare
515            return prepare.command(args)
516        if action == "doctor":
517            return _cli().cmd_factory_doctor(args)
518        if action == "bootstrap":
519            return _cli().cmd_factory_bootstrap(args)
520        if action == "canary":
521            args.max_work_items = 1
522            if not getattr(args, "until", None):
523                args.until = None
524            return _cli().cmd_factory_run(args)
525        if action == "queue":
526            from howlplane.control_plane.factory import task_queue
527            return task_queue.command(args)
528        print("Unknown factory action.")
529        return 1
530    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
531        from howlplane.control_plane.presentation.errors import OperatorError, OperatorFailure
532        raise OperatorFailure(OperatorError(
533            "FACTORY_INPUT_ERROR", f"Factory: {exc}",
534            "The Factory command could not use the repository, state directory or arguments given.",
535            "Check the arguments and the repository, then run the readiness check.",
536            "howlplane factory doctor")) from exc

1059        repo_dir=repo_dir,
1060    )
1061
1062    if getattr(args, "json", False):
1063        print(json.dumps(res.to_dict(), indent=2))
1064    else:
1065        print("=" * 60)
1066        print("HOWLDREAM EXPLORATION RESULT")
1067        print("=" * 60)

1069        print(f"Policy:             {res.policy}")
1070        print(f"Objective:          {res.objective}")
1071        print(f"Candidates Found:   {len(res.candidates)}")
1072        print(f"Assessments Done:   {len(res.assessments)}")
1073        print(f"Developed (Sandbox):{len(res.development_results)}")
1074        if res.envelope_path:

1078        print(f"Duration:           {res.duration_seconds}s")
1079        print("=" * 60)
1080
1081    if res.status in ("SUCCESS", "NO_CANDIDATES", "SKIPPED", "UNAVAILABLE"):
1082        return 0
1083    elif res.status == "REJECTED":
1084        return 1
1085    else:
1086        return 2

Executes a governed HowlDream exploration cycle.

def cmd_trace(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int: 
1089def cmd_trace(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
1090    """Traces descent lineage DAG for an exploration run or candidate."""
1091    import json
1092    repo_dir = Path(getattr(args, "repo_dir", None) or ".").resolve()
1093    trace_id = args.trace_id
1094
1095    try:
1096        has_howldream = False
1097        try:
1098            from howldream.contracts import DescentDAG
1099
1100            has_howldream = True
1101        except ImportError:
1102            DescentDAG = None
1103
1104        found_chain = None
1105        for envelope_path in repo_dir.glob("**/exploration_envelope.json"):
1106            if envelope_path.is_file():
1107                with open(envelope_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
1108                    env_data = json.load(f)
1109                dag_data = env_data.get("descent_dag") or env_data.get("lineage_dag")
1110                if not dag_data:
1111                    continue
1112
1113                if has_howldream and DescentDAG is not None:
1114                    dag = DescentDAG.model_validate(dag_data)
1115                    if trace_id in dag.nodes:
1116                        chain = dag.trace(trace_id)
1117                        found_chain = [node.model_dump() for node in chain]
1118                        break
1119                else:
1120                    nodes = dag_data.get("nodes", {})
1121                    if isinstance(nodes, list):
1122                        nodes = {n.get("node_id"): n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, dict)}
1123                    if trace_id in nodes:
1124                        edges = dag_data.get("edges", [])
1125                        visited = set()
1126                        chain = []
1127
1128                        def _walk(curr: str):
1129                            if curr in visited or curr not in nodes:
1130                                return
1131                            visited.add(curr)
1132                            chain.append(nodes[curr])
1133                            for edge in edges:
1134                                if isinstance(edge, dict) and edge.get("target") == curr:
1135                                    src = edge.get("source")
1136                                    if src:
1137                                        _walk(src)
1138
1139                        _walk(trace_id)
1140                        found_chain = chain
1141                        break
1142
1143        if found_chain is not None:
1144            if getattr(args, "json", False):
1145                print(json.dumps(found_chain, indent=2))
1146            else:
1147                print(f"Lineage trace for '{trace_id}' ({len(found_chain)} nodes):")
1148                for node in found_chain:
1149                    node_type = node.get("node_type", "unknown")
1150                    node_id = node.get("node_id", "")
1151                    label = node.get("label", "")
1152                    print(f"  - [{node_type}] {node_id}: {label}")
1153            return 0
1154        else:
1155            print(f"Node or candidate '{trace_id}' not found in lineage DAGs.")
1156            return 1
1157    except Exception as exc:
1158        print(f"Error tracing '{trace_id}': {exc}")
1159        return 1

Traces descent lineage DAG for an exploration run or candidate.

def register_exploration_subparsers(subparsers: Any, parents: Optional[List[Any]] = None) -> None: 
1511def register_exploration_subparsers(subparsers: Any, parents: Optional[List[Any]] = None) -> None:
1512    kwargs = {"parents": parents} if parents else {}
1513    # explore
1514    p_exp = subparsers.add_parser("explore", help="Run governed HowlDream exploration", **kwargs)
1515    p_exp.add_argument("objective", help="Exploration objective")
1516    p_exp.add_argument(
1517        "--policy",
1518        choices=["NEVER", "MANUAL", "SUGGEST", "ALLOWED", "AUTOMATIC_WITH_BUDGET"],
1519        default="MANUAL",
1520        help="Exploration governance policy",
1521    )
1522    p_exp.add_argument("--budget-candidates", type=int, default=5, help="Candidate limit")
1523    p_exp.add_argument("--budget-trials", type=int, default=3, help="Trial limit")
1524    p_exp.add_argument("--budget-tokens", type=int, default=10000, help="Token budget")
1525    p_exp.add_argument("--repo-dir", default=".", help="Target repository directory")
1526    p_exp.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Output JSON result")
1527
1528    # trace
1529    p_trc = subparsers.add_parser("trace", help="Trace lineage DAG for a candidate or node", **kwargs)
1530    p_trc.add_argument("trace_id", help="Node, candidate, or dream ID to trace")
1531    p_trc.add_argument("--repo-dir", default=".", help="Target repository directory")

def build_parser(program_name: str = 'howlplane') -> argparse.ArgumentParser: 
1215def build_parser(program_name: str = "howlplane") -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
1216    common_parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
1217    common_parser.add_argument(
1218        "--control-plane-dir",
1219        "-C",
1220        help="Explicit path to HowlPlane control plane repository",
1221    )
1222    common_parser.add_argument(
1223        "--repo",
1224        "-R",
1225        help="Target Git repository directory (defaults to current working directory discovery)",
1226    )
1227
1228    task_base_parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
1229    task_base_parser.add_argument("objective", help="Task objective or description")
1230    task_base_parser.add_argument("--task-id", help="Explicit task ID")
1231    task_base_parser.add_argument("--risk", choices=["low", "medium", "high", "critical"], help="Risk level override")
1232    task_base_parser.add_argument("--tier", choices=["tier_1", "tier_2", "tier_3"], help="Reasoning tier override")
1233    task_base_parser.add_argument("--agent", help="Preferred agent override")
1234
1235    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
1236        prog=program_name,
1237        description="Deterministic Multi-Agent Engineering Control Plane CLI\n\n" + _TOP_LEVEL_QUICKSTART,
1238        formatter_class=_grouped_help_formatter(_TOP_LEVEL_HELP_GROUPS, "Advanced engineering"),
1239        parents=[common_parser],
1240    )
1241    parser.add_argument(
1242        "--version",
1243        action="version",
1244        version=f"{program_name} {__version__}",
1245    )
1246    # Handled by main() before parsing so they work before or after the command.
1247    parser.add_argument("--color", metavar="MODE", help="auto (default), always or never; NO_COLOR is honored")

def _print_orchestration_summary( res: howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator.OrchestrationResult, ctx: howlplane.control_plane.project_adapter.ProjectContext, spec: howlplane.control_plane.task_spec.TaskSpec, decision: howlplane.control_plane.router.RoutingDecision) -> None: 
388def _print_orchestration_summary(
389    res: OrchestrationResult,
390    ctx: ProjectContext,
391    spec: TaskSpec,
392    decision: RoutingDecision,
393) -> None:
394    """Renders the standard terminal output after governed task execution."""
395    status_header = "COMPLETE" if res.final_state == "complete" else (
396        "AWAITING HUMAN APPROVAL" if res.final_state == "awaiting_human" else "FAILED"
397    )
398    print("=" * 60)
399    print(f"HOWLPLANE — GOVERNED TASK {status_header}")
400    print("=" * 60)
401    print(f"Task:              {spec.task_id}")
402    print(f"Repository:        {ctx.name}")
403    print(f"Risk:              {spec.risk_level.upper()}")
404    print("")
405    print("Project Context:")
406    print("  ProjectAdapter:  OK")
407    hf_status = res.howlframe_audit_status
408    if not hf_status and getattr(res, "run_dir", None):
409        audit_path = Path(res.run_dir) / "howlframe_audit.json"
410        if audit_path.exists():
411            try:
412                audit_data = json.loads(audit_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
413                hf_status = audit_data.get("audit_status") or audit_data.get("status")
414            except Exception:
415                pass
416
417    if hf_status:
418        hf_str = hf_status
419    elif res.howlframe_audit_match is True:
420        hf_str = "PASS / MATCH (shadow)"
421    elif res.howlframe_audit_match is False:
422        hf_str = "MISMATCH"
423    else:
424        hf_str = "NOT COMPUTED"
425    print(f"  HowlFrame:       {hf_str}")
426    print("")
427    print("Routing:")
428    final_impl_name = res.executing_provider or decision.selected_agent_name
429    print(f"  Implementation:  {final_impl_name}")
430    if res.executing_provider and res.executing_provider != decision.selected_agent_id:
431        print(f"  Initial route:   {decision.selected_agent_name}")
432    print(f"  Reasoning Tier:  {decision.reasoning_tier}")
433    print("")
434    print("Implementation:")
435    delta = res.final_delta
436    is_failed_impl = (
437        res.final_state == "failed"
438        and res.provider_execution is not None
439        and not res.provider_execution.success
440    )
441    if is_failed_impl:
442        print("  Status:                     FAILED")
443        provider_name = res.executing_provider or decision.selected_agent_name
444        print(f"  Provider:                   {provider_name}")
445        has_partial = delta is not None and not delta.is_empty
446        print(f"  Partial repository changes: {'YES' if has_partial else 'NO'}")
447        fc = (len(delta.files_modified) + len(delta.files_added)) if has_partial else 0
448        ins = delta.insertions if has_partial else 0
449        dels = delta.deletions if has_partial else 0
450        print(f"  Files Changed:              {fc}")
451        print(f"  Insertions:                  {ins}")
452        print(f"  Deletions:                  {dels}")
453        if has_partial:
454            print("  Changes reviewed:           NO")
455            print("  Changes verified:           NO")
456    else:
457        fc = (len(delta.files_modified) + len(delta.files_added)) if delta else 0
458        ins = delta.insertions if delta else 0
459        dels = delta.deletions if delta else 0
460        print(f"  Files Changed:   {fc}")
461        print(f"  Insertions:       {ins}")
462        print(f"  Deletions:       {dels}")
463    _print_failover_accounting(res)
464    print("Review:")
465    if res.review_cycles:
466        last_cycle = res.review_cycles[-1]
467        non_independent = set(getattr(last_cycle, "non_independent_roles", []) or [])
468        for role_id in decision.recommended_reviewers:
469            role_res = last_cycle.reviewer_results.get(role_id)
470            role_label = role_id.replace("-reviewer", "").capitalize()
471            if role_res is None:
472                status_text = "NOT RUN"
473            elif role_res.status == "reviewer_failure":
474                status_text = "FAILED (no verdict)"
475            elif role_res.findings:
476                sev_summary = f"{role_res.findings[0].severity.upper()}"
477                status_text = f"{sev_summary} → REMEDIATED" if res.final_state == "complete" and res.remediation_cycles_count > 0 else f"{sev_summary} ({len(role_res.findings)} findings)"
478            else:
479                status_text = "PASS"
480            if role_id in non_independent:
481                status_text = f"{status_text} ⚠ SELF-REVIEW (implementer)"
482            print(f"  {role_label:<17} {status_text}")
483    else:
484        print("  (No review cycles executed)")
485    print("")
486    print("Remediation:")
487    print(f"  Cycles:           {res.remediation_cycles_count}")
488    print("")
489    print("Verification:")
490    if res.verification_plan and res.verification_plan.steps:
491        executed_steps = [
492            s for s in res.verification_plan.steps
493            if s.exit_code is not None or s.status in ("verified", "failed")
494        ]
495        if not executed_steps:
496            total_steps = len(res.verification_plan.steps)
497            print(f"  Discovered:      {total_steps} steps")
498            print("  Executed:        0")
499            if res.final_state == "failed":
500                print("  Status:          NOT RUN — implementation failed before verification")
501            else:
502                print(f"  Status:          NOT RUN — task {res.final_state} before verification")
503        else:
504            for s in res.verification_plan.steps:
505                status_tag = "VERIFIED" if s.status == "verified" else s.status.upper()
506                print(f"  {s.name:<17} {status_tag}")
507    else:
508        print("  (No automated verification steps discovered)")
509    print("")
510    print("Human Authority:")
511    req_human = (res.final_state == "awaiting_human") or bool(
512        res.boundary_result and res.boundary_result.requires_human_approval
513    )
514    print(f"  Required:         {'Yes (🛑 Triggered)' if req_human else 'No'}")
515    print("")
516    print("Evidence:")
517    print(f"  {res.run_dir}/")
518    print("")
519    final_verdict = (
520        "VERIFIED COMPLETE" if res.final_state == "complete"
521        else ("AWAITING HUMAN AUTHORIZATION" if res.final_state == "awaiting_human" else "FAILED")
522    )
523    print(f"Final State:\n  {final_verdict}")
524    print("=" * 60)

Renders the standard terminal output after governed task execution.

def _print_failover_accounting(res: howlplane.control_plane.orchestrator.OrchestrationResult) -> None: 
349def _print_failover_accounting(res: OrchestrationResult) -> None:
350    """Explains multi-attempt implementation so exhaustion is never a mystery."""
351    attempts = res.implementation_attempts or []
352    summary = res.failover_summary or {}
353    if len(attempts) <= 1 and res.final_state != "failed":
354        print("")
355        return
356    print("")
357    print("Implementation attempts:")
358    for attempt in attempts:
359        label = attempt.get("resource_id") or "unknown"
360        outcome = (
361            "SUCCESS" if attempt.get("success")
362            else (attempt.get("failure_class") or "FAILED")
363        )
364        print(f"  {attempt.get('attempt')}. {label:<14} {outcome}")
365    if not attempts:
366        print("  (none recorded)")
367    if summary:
368        print("")
369        print("Failover:")
370        print(
371            "  Attempts used:                "
372            f"{summary.get('attempts_used')}/{summary.get('attempts_allowed')}"
373        )
374        remaining = summary.get("remaining_eligible") or []
375        print(
376            "  Remaining eligible resources: "
377            f"{', '.join(remaining) if remaining else 'none'}"
378        )
379        print(f"  Termination reason:           {summary.get('termination_reason')}")
380        excluded = summary.get("excluded") or {}
381        if excluded:
382            print("  Excluded resources:")
383            for resource_id, reason in sorted(excluded.items()):
384                print(f"    {resource_id:<14} {reason}")
385    print("")

Explains multi-attempt implementation so exhaustion is never a mystery.

def main(args: Optional[List[str]] = None, program_name: str = 'howlplane') -> int: 
2575def main(args: Optional[List[str]] = None, program_name: str = "howlplane") -> int:
2576    """Runs the canonical HowlPlane control plane launcher."""
2577    if args is None:
2578        args = sys.argv[1:]
2579    global _COLOR_MODE
2580    args, debug, _COLOR_MODE = _extract_global_flags(list(args))
2581    if _COLOR_MODE is not None and _COLOR_MODE not in ("auto", "always", "never"):
2582        print("--color must be one of: auto, always, never", file=sys.stderr)
2583        return 2
2584    parser = build_parser(program_name=program_name)
2585    parsed_args = parser.parse_args(args)
2586
2587    if not parsed_args.subcommand:
2588        if program_name != "howlplane":
2589            # The deprecated `ai` entry point keeps its original behavior.
2590            parser.print_help()
2591            return 1
2592        handler = cmd_home
2593    else:
2594        handler = HANDLERS.get(parsed_args.subcommand)
2595    if not handler:
2596        parser.print_help()
2597        return 1
2598
2599    try:
2600        # One resolution point: an explicit --workspace-trust overrides config for
2601        # this process and every agent, session, and service it launches.
2602        from howlplane.control_plane import workspace_trust
2603        workspace_trust.set_cli_policy(getattr(parsed_args, "workspace_trust", None))
2604        # Fail fast on an invalid environment or config value, before any work starts.
2605        # `config` explains invalid values itself, so it must be reachable when they are wrong.
2606        if parsed_args.subcommand != "config":
2607            workspace_trust.resolve_policy()
2608        return handler(parsed_args)
2609    except Exception as err:
2610        return _report_failure(err, parsed_args, debug)

Runs the canonical HowlPlane control plane launcher.

def legacy_main(args: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int: 
2660def legacy_main(args: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
2661    """Runs the deprecated ai compatibility entry point without altering stdout."""
2662    print(
2663        "'ai' is deprecated. Use the Howl ecosystem CLI when available, or "
2664        "'howlplane' for direct HowlPlane access.",
2665        file=sys.stderr,
2666    )
2667    launcher_mod = sys.modules.get("howlplane.control_plane.launcher")
2668    if launcher_mod and hasattr(launcher_mod, "main") and launcher_mod.main is not main:
2669        return launcher_mod.main(args, program_name="ai")
2670    return main(args, program_name="ai")
